title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative - Lindon, UT
description:
Job Description:

FIELD SALES AND MARKETING REPRESENTATIVE – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provides TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this position, you will drive sales of our premier product lines within one of our largest retail partners. This position will allow you to enhance your selling, account management, and communication skills while launching your career in a fast-paced and extremely rewarding company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

•        Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm

•        Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through

•        Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through

•        Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets— leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact

•        Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics

•        Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market

•        Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships

•        Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities

•        Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

•        Must be at least 21 years of age or older

•        Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions

•        Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening

•        Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state

•        Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation

•        Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver

•        Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required

•        Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies)

•        Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product

•        Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed

•        Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays

•        Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year

•        Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks

•        Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills  •     The applicant must be MS Office proficient

•        Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs

•        Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered

•        Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities

Compensation and Benefits:

•        Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

•        The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

•        Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

•        Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

•        Company iPhone and iPad

•        Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

•        Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

•        401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

•        Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holidays (Based on hire date)

•        Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

•        Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

•        Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications as various positions are available nationwide.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at https://www.ttigroup.com/careers/us.

title: Firmware Test Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive modern technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we are pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you will be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you will have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Firmware Test Engineer II will collaborate and establish trusting relationships with cross-functional engineering and testing teams to support Test Management across the firmware verification lifecycle.  You will help translate requirements into clear, testable, traceable and automation-ready verification solutions that support new product development deliverables at key milestones.

You will also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Review firmware, hardware, and system requirements for clarity, completeness, and testability.

• Identify requirement gaps, ambiguities, risks, and traceability issues.

• Design and maintain test cases for firmware features and subsystems of low- to mid-level complexity with supervision from Senior/Principal engineers.

• Support HIL test development by identifying needed interfaces, instrumentation, and test resources.

• Develop and maintain Python-based automated test scripts.

• Configure and execute tests using HIL systems, development hardware, and laboratory equipment.

• Analyze test failures and help isolate issues to firmware, hardware, test automation, or test setup.

• Document test results, objective evidence, and defects with clear, reproducible details.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile projects and participate in technical reviews.

• Contribute to reusable test assets, automation frameworks, process improvements, and continuous learning.

• Use Agile methods to define tasks, provide estimates, and communicate progress to ensure adherence to schedule and Milwaukee Tool’s processes.

• Schedule, develop agendas for, lead, and document technical meetings and formal presentations.

What TOOLS you will bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field

• 2+ years of experience with verification and validation testing, embedded systems and/or PCBA design.

• Experience with requirements management, defect tracking, source control, or peer review tools such as JAMA, Azure DevOps, Jira, Polarion, or similar platforms.

• Ability to read schematics and datasheets and apply a working understanding of digital circuits and firmware/electronics interaction.

• Experience developing or reviewing test cases or test procedures from requirements.

• Working proficiency in Python, including the ability to write, execute, and debug test scripts.

• Familiarity with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, data acquisition systems, or multimeters.

• Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate failures across software, firmware, hardware, and test setup boundaries.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document requirements gaps, test rationale, results, and defects clearly.

• Experience collaborating cross-functionally outside of your core discipline which includes accepting technical feedback, managing assigned work, and exercising sound judgment with appropriate guidance.

• Ability to travel up to 10%, domestically and internationally.

Other TOOLS, we prefer you to have:

• Exposure HIL testing, simulation, test-fixture development, or automated test systems.

• Experience with National Instruments hardware, TestStand, VeriStand, or LabVIEW.

• Experience with black-box and white-box testing, bare-metal firmware, embedded C or C++, unit testing, or structural testing methods.

• Exposure to DevOps, automated regression testing, or continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

• Experience using AI-assisted engineering or programming tools to

• improve productivity and quality.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401(k) savings plan.

• Education assistance.

• On-site wellness resources, fitness centers, food, and coffee service.

• And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: UX Designer
description:
Job Description:

At Milwaukee Tool, we believe our people and culture are the foundation of our success. As we continue to expand our digitally enabled products and services, we are looking for UX Designers who are passionate about solving customer problems and creating intuitive, effective experiences.

Our digital ecosystem supports customers across web, mobile, connected products, and emerging technologies. Working within established and evolving UX frameworks, standards, and design systems, you'll help shape experiences that are cohesive, scalable, and aligned with both customer and business needs.

Your Role on Our Team:

As a UX Designer, you will participate throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery through solution development, understanding user needs and translating research insights, technical capabilities, and product requirements into thoughtful interface and interaction solutions.

You will collaborate closely with Product Management, Research, Engineering, and cross-functional partners to deliver customer-centered solutions.

The ideal candidate is an independent and collaborative designer who can take ownership of complex design challenges, contribute during discovery and planning, and carry work from concept through implementation.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Partner with Product Management and Research to understand customer problems, identify opportunities, and contribute to discovery directly with Product Management as needed.

• Design experiences for multi-platform products and solutions across web, iOS, Android, and connected hardware.

• Balance customer, business, and technical needs to simplify complex workflows and inform design decisions.

• Break down complex initiatives into manageable design activities, identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities for incremental delivery.

• Apply systems thinking to create cohesive experiences across products, platforms, and Milwaukee Tool's design system.

• Collaborate closely with Product Management, Product Owners, Engineering, Industrial Design, Development, other UX Designers, and Quality Assurance partners throughout the product lifecycle.

• Take ownership of your work from discovery through implementation and ensure a high level of quality and craftsmanship throughout.

• Generate concepts and prototypes, validating solutions through customer feedback and testing as needed.

• Share work early and often to gather feedback, build alignment, and influence decisions.

• Communicate design rationale and implementation requirements while ensuring experience quality through launch.

• Contribute to team quality and the evolution of the UX practice through collaboration, constructive feedback, shared learning, and continuous improvement.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• 3-5 years of experience as a UX Designer, Interaction Designer, Product Designer, or similar role.

• Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or equivalent professional experience.

• Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

• Experience contributing to discovery, problem framing, or early product planning activities.

• Ability to communicate complex ideas and design rationale through appropriate design artifacts and stakeholder discussions.

• Demonstrated ability to break down complex work, plan effectively, and manage priorities across multiple initiatives.

• Working knowledge of design research methods, including end user interviews, concept evaluation, and usability testing.

• Experience designing iteratively, shipping digital products, and using customer feedback to improve outcomes.

• Experience applying design systems, mobile platform conventions, and responsive design principles.

• Experience using AI-assisted tools to support design workflows, exploration, or product experiences is a plus.

• Portfolio demonstrating UX thinking, systems thinking, end-to-end design process, and shipped work is required.

The TOOLS we prefer you have:

• Strong ownership, initiative, and accountability.

• A collaborative approach that builds trust across disciplines.

• Curiosity, adaptability, and comfort working through ambiguity.

• A growth mindset and desire to continuously improve.

• A healthy balance of humility and confidence.

• Alignment with Milwaukee Tool's core culture principles, One Team Mentality, Candid Communication, Always Improving, Speed, Agility, Urgency, and Empowered Leadership.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans

• Generous 401 (K) savings plan

• Education assistance

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service

description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc. is seeking a Stand-Up Forklift Operator for our Day Shift Manufacturing operations in Anderson, SC. We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including tuition assistance, 401(k), medical, dental, vision coverage, paid vacation, and holidays.

Position Summary

The Stand-Up Forklift Operator is responsible for safely operating powered industrial equipment while supporting warehouse and manufacturing operations through picking, packing, repackaging, unloading, and inventory-related activities. This position plays a critical role in maintaining product accuracy, safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Complete assigned picking, packing, repackaging, and unloading tasks.

• Operate stand-up forklift and material handling equipment safely and efficiently.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

• Ensure inventory accuracy and order fulfillment accuracy.

• Follow all company safety, security, and quality policies.

• Utilize basic math skills and weight scales to complete job functions.

• Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).

• Demonstrate a cooperative and professional attitude with coworkers and management.

• Adhere to production schedules and work overtime and weekends as needed.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the department.

• Perform additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

• High School Diploma or GED preferred.

Experience

• Minimum of 3 to 6 months of experience in a manufacturing or warehouse environment preferred.

• Previous forklift operation experience required.

• Licensed or certified Lift Truck Operator required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Ability to accurately add and multiply numbers.

• Ability to read and understand written English instructions.

• Ability to work from pick lists, work orders, and operating instructions.

• Ability to maintain productivity standards, including picking up to 200 line items.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand for extended periods.

• Frequent repetitive motion throughout the shift.

• Frequent bending, stooping, pushing, and pulling.

• Regular lifting of up to 50 pounds independently.

• Team lifting required for items exceeding 50 pounds.

• Ability to work in varying temperature conditions.

• Ability to continuously move products of varying weights throughout the workday.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Working Conditions

• Fast-paced warehouse and manufacturing environment.

• Exposure to moving equipment, forklifts, and warehouse traffic.

• Variable temperatures depending on season and operational needs.

• Overtime and weekend work may be required based on business demands.

Key Performance Expectations

• Maintain safety compliance with zero preventable incidents.

• Meet picking and productivity standards.

• Achieve inventory and order accuracy goals.

• Adhere to quality requirements and operational procedures.

• Demonstrate reliability, attendance, and teamwork.

Internal Candidate Requirements

Internal applicants must meet the following qualifications:

• No active Final Written Warnings.

• No more than six (6) attendance points.

• Meet efficiency and quality performance standards for the previous three months.

• Minimum of six (6) months in current position.

• Meet all qualifications and requirements outlined in this job description.

title: Project Engineer I
description:
Job Description:

Project Engineer I – New Product Development Engineering (OPE)

The Project Engineer I supports the cross-functional execution of new product development (NPD) programs for outdoor power equipment (OPE). Working under the guidance of experienced project leaders and engineering leadership, this role helps translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, maintains project plans and risk visibility, coordinates technical deliverables, and supports products from concept through production. The Project Engineer I develops project leadership capability while building strong technical judgment, communication, and accountability.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Project Scope & Requirements

• Supports development and maintenance of product requirements, engineering specifications, and critical-to-quality (CTQ) measures for assigned projects.

• Helps identify where requirements create challenges to performance, cost, quality, or schedule.

• Supports scoping of assigned systems, subsystems, and project deliverables with guidance from senior project leadership.

• Documents decisions, assumptions, open questions, and changes to project scope.

Schedule, Risk & Execution

• Develops and maintains work breakdown structures, action trackers, milestone plans, and project documentation for lower-complexity projects or defined workstreams.

• Tracks deliverables, identifies emerging schedule threats, and escalates issues when support or cross-functional alignment is needed.

• Supports project risk reviews by documenting likelihood, impact, mitigation actions, owners, and closure evidence.

• Coordinates prototype builds, testing, design reviews, pilot builds, and release activities with functional owners.

• Demonstrates consistent follow-through and personal accountability for assigned actions.

Cost, Quality & Product Performance

• Supports product cost tracking, competitive benchmarking, design trade-off analysis, and value engineering activities.

• Works with Design Engineering, Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Compliance, Reliability, and suppliers to resolve project issues.

• Uses data from testing, builds, and supplier feedback to help the team evaluate options and make informed decisions.

• Supports compliance with internal standards and applicable UL, ANSI, CSA, and ISO expectations.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication

• Facilitates routine project meetings or defined agenda sections with coaching; records decisions, owners, and due dates.

• Communicates project information clearly through written updates, presentations, and action summaries.

• Builds productive relationships with domestic and global team members and actively incorporates input from others.

• Proactively communicates obstacles and seeks help early enough to protect project commitments.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in engineering, product development, manufacturing, or project work; internships and co-op assignments count toward this requirement.

• Working knowledge of engineering fundamentals, drawings, product testing, and structured problem solving.

• Ability to organize technical information, maintain action trackers, and communicate clearly across functions.

• Strong analytical, planning, and follow-through skills.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, consumer products, or electromechanical systems.

• Familiarity with NPD stage-gate processes, DFMEA, CTQ development, and design verification.

• Experience supporting prototype or pilot builds and working with global suppliers.

• Basic proficiency with project scheduling, data analysis, and Microsoft Office tools.

Travel

• Up to 10% travel (international and domestic).

title: Project Leader
description:
Job Description:

Project Leader – New Product Development Engineering (OPE)

The Project Leader is accountable for the successful cross-functional delivery of moderate to high-complexity new product development (NPD) programs for outdoor power equipment (OPE). Acting as the primary integrator for the project, this role aligns the team on product requirements and strategy, owns the integrated program plan, and drives closure of gaps related to performance, cost, quality, and schedule. The Project Leader leads through influence, maintains the appropriate level of detail to proactively identify risks, barriers, and decision points, and ensures timely escalation of issues that cannot be resolved within the project team. This role communicates clear, data-driven, and decision-ready recommendations to leadership, enabling effective prioritization and rapid resolution of critical program challenges.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Project Strategy & Scope Ownership

• Owns the coordinated delivery of technical and business objectives, ensuring alignment with both internal and external customer requirements

• Drives convergence of performance, features, cost, schedule, quality, and risk trade-offs.

• Ensures the cross-functional team understands priorities, success criteria, decision rights, and required deliverables.

• Challenges assumptions and identifies opportunities to improve the product, execution plan, and business outcome.

Integrated Execution & Risk Leadership

• Owns the integrated project schedule, critical path, milestone readiness, and operating rhythm across all functions.

• Drives timely closure of cross-functional gaps and escalates constraints when additional authority, resources, or business decisions are required.

• Leads project risk management, including identification, prioritization, mitigation, investment, contingency planning, and decision timing.

• Ensures functional owners maintain credible task-level plans while holding the team accountable for commitments.

• Leads projects independently and adapts the plan as priorities, risks, and business conditions change.

Financial, Quality & Launch Accountability

• Owns product cost, tooling, capital, project spending, and the financial impact of project decisions.

• Drives closure of gaps to product performance, reliability, regulatory, quality, manufacturability, supplier readiness, and launch targets.

• Partners with Operations, Quality, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and suppliers to establish specifications and deliver conforming products.

• Ensures project decisions support scalable, sustainable production and a successful ramp-up.

Team Leadership & Executive Communication

• Creates alignment and accountability between cross functional project teams.

• Provides candid, concise executive updates that communicate status through the lens of outcomes, risks, trade-offs, decisions, and support needed.

·        Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

·        Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

·        Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

·        Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

·        Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

·        Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

·        Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

·        Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

·        Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

·        Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

·        Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

·        Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

·        Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

·        Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

title: Transportation Analyst I
description:
Job Description:

The Transportation Analyst I provides day-to-day operational and analytical support for Milwaukee Tool’s transportation network. Serving as a first point of contact for transportation-related needs. This role coordinates inbound and outbound shipments, supports carrier performance and compliance, resolves service issues, manages freight claims, carrier invoice payment exceptions, and identifies opportunities to improve quality, service, and costs. The analyst partners across the organization to deliver reliable transportation solutions and uses data to support fact-based decisions and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills, along with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, AI tools, and PowerPoint.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Coordinate inbound and outbound transportation activities, including shipment scheduling, routing, booking, tracking, expediting, and delivery follow-up.

• Partner cross-functionally with Supply Planning, Sourcing, Service, Manufacturing, Sales, Merchandising, Distribution, suppliers, and carriers to support business and customer requirements.

• Monitor daily shipment activity and proactively resolve lost, misrouted, delayed, or damaged freight with carriers and internal stakeholders.

• Provide freight quotes and secure carrier capacity for expedited, ad hoc, and special shipment requests.

• Evaluate expedited shipment requests and recommend the most cost-effective service option; escalate excess-cost transactions for appropriate approval.

• Develop and maintain routing guides, supplier requirements, and transportation compliance standards that balance service, quality, and cost objectives.

• Analyze freight and routing data to identify noncompliance, service gaps, cost drivers, and process-improvement opportunities.

• Track carrier performance across transportation modes, communicate results, and escalate recurring service issues for corrective action.

• Manage freight claims, including claim submission, documentation, follow-up, and recovery tracking.

• Research and resolve transportation-related customer issues in collaboration with carriers and the broader distribution network.

• Support freight payment exception resolution and help ensure transportation charges are accurate and appropriately documented.

• Lead or support data-driven cost mitigation and continuous-improvement initiatives.

• Provide operational coverage and support for the Transportation Manager as needed.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• 0-2 years of experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, or a related operational environment preferred.· Bachelor’s degree in transportation, operations, logistics, supply chain management, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant education and experience will be considered.

• Ability to extract, organize, manipulate, and interpret transportation and operational data.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate findings into practical recommendations.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills for working with carriers, suppliers, customers, and internal business partners.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to time-sensitive issues, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions and contribute within a one-team environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.

description:
Job Description:

Excited to grow your career?

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

Our people make all the difference in our success.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to drive disruptive new technologies and solutions across our operations teams. Our Operations Teams are responsible for the manufacturing, service, supply chain, and quality systems that bring our products to life and into the hands of our users. We continue to invest in advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI capabilities to transform how we run our plants, optimize production, and anticipate issues before they reach the line. We’re pushing the limits in data engineering, deep learning, and generative AI applied to real-world manufacturing problems.

Your role on our team:

As a Machine Learning Engineer II, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions that improve how Milwaukee Tool manufactures and services products. Working cross-functionally with operations, quality, supply chain, engineering, and service teams, you will develop and implement data-driven solutions that address real-world business and operational challenges globally.

You will contribute to the full machine learning lifecycle, from data engineering and model development to deployment and monitoring on Azure and Databricks. A key aspect of this role is partnering with our Global and Service Teams to deploy, validate, and support machine learning solutions in operational environments, ensuring models deliver measurable value where they are used.

This role is ideal for a self-motivated engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams, and takes ownership of delivering impactful, production-ready solutions.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Advanced Engineering
description:
Job Description:

Mechanical Design Engineer - Advanced Engineering

Applicants must currently hold a U.S. work-authorized status that supports long-term employment and a pathway to permanent residency. Candidates in visitor, student, exchange, treaty investor/trader, or other temporary statuses that do not readily support employment-based permanent residency will not be considered.

Techtronic Industries, the world leader in cordless technology across Outdoor Power Equipment, Power Tools, Floor Care Appliances, and Accessories, is seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer for the Ryobi Outdoor Products Advanced Engineering team at our Innovation Center in Anderson, SC.

This role is ideal for a hands-on mechanical engineer who enjoys turning ambiguous product ideas into working, tested, manufacturable solutions before they enter formal product development. You will help develop future outdoor power equipment technologies by converting early concepts into validated mechanical systems that improve performance, durability, user experience, and manufacturability.

Advanced Engineering operates upstream of traditional new product development. The team explores new mechanisms, proves out key technical assumptions, reduces risk through analysis, prototyping, and testing, and transitions mature concepts to product development teams.

The Advanced Engineering team is highly collaborative, deeply hands-on, and driven by curiosity, learning, and practical problem solving as we develop innovative outdoor products that create real value for our customers.

What You’ll Do:

• Develop advanced mechanical concepts for next-generation outdoor power equipment and battery-powered outdoor products

• Create mechanisms, structures, and integrated assemblies that balance performance, durability, manufacturability, cost, and user experience

• Use first-principles analysis, hand calculations, simulation, benchmarking, and test data to guide design decisions

• Build, test, and iterate functional prototypes to quickly validate key assumptions, identify risks, and mature concepts

• Define system requirements, user operation methods, design trade-offs, and acceptance criteria for advanced mechanical systems

• Translate early concepts into robust, production-minded designs that can be handed off to downstream engineering teams

• Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Industrial Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to develop balanced technical solutions

• Communicate technical findings, risks, recommendations, and next steps clearly to engineering leadership and project stakeholders

• Support project planning by contributing to milestone definition, schedule inputs, prototype needs, and technical risk assessments

Required Qualifications:

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline

• 3+ years of mechanical design experience in product development, advanced engineering, concept maturation, or innovation-focused roles

• Strong proficiency with 3D CAD, such as NX, SolidWorks, or similar tools

• Strong mechanical design fundamentals, including mechanisms, structures, engineering materials, manufacturing processes, and tolerance considerations

• Experience building prototypes, developing test plans, evaluating results, and using data to improve designs

• Ability to manage multiple projects or concepts at different stages of maturity

• Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, ownership, curiosity, and proactivity

• Willingness to travel approximately 5-10%, including domestic and international travel as needed

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience designing consumer products, outdoor power equipment, power tools, or similar high-volume mechanical products

• Experience using FEA, CFD, dynamic simulation, gear design tools, or other advanced analysis methods to guide product design

• Experience with rapid prototyping across multiple materials and processes

• Familiarity with vibration, sound, airflow, thermal, durability, or performance testing

• Familiarity with integrated electrical and mechanical systems, including motors, batteries, sensors, and control interfaces

• Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field

Tools & Technologies:
Candidates should be comfortable using modern engineering tools to develop, analyze, communicate, and validate mechanical designs.

• Relevant tools include MS Office, NX, SolidWorks, Ansys Mechanical, LS-DYNA, Fluent, Discovery, KISSsoft, rapid prototyping equipment, and measurement tools for vibration, sound, airflow, durability, or product performance.

Why Join This Team?

• Work on future product platforms and advanced technologies before they enter formal product development

• Use hands-on prototyping, testing, and analysis to influence real product decisions

• Collaborate closely with product, design, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and leadership teams

• Gain high visibility by helping define product architectures, technical strategies, and risk-reduction plans

• Help shape the technical direction of products that reach a large base of real-world users

Ideal Candidate Profile:

• A self-starter who can move quickly from idea to prototype while staying grounded in engineering fundamentals

• A maker-minded engineer who enjoys building, testing, troubleshooting, and learning through iteration

• A collaborative contributor who brings broad technical experience, curiosity, and practical creativity to technical brainstorming

• A clear communicator who can translate complex technical information for technical and non-technical stakeholders

• An engineer who is comfortable with ambiguity and can reduce uncertainty through analysis, testing, and data-driven design decisions

• A practical innovator who wants to help shape future outdoor products that users can feel, hear, see, and experience

• Support the stability, performance, and scalability of assigned capabilities across manufacturing plants and distribution centers, including critical business events.

• Maintain appropriate solution documentation and traceability throughout the platform delivery lifecycle.

• Mentor and elevate less experienced Oracle Platform analysts through knowledge sharing, solution design review, and hands-on technical guidance.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field, and/or equivalent technical and business experience.

• Multiple years of hands-on experience configuring and supporting Oracle Fusion SCM Manufacturing and Inventory in a functional platform role.

• Strong knowledge of manufacturing and inventory business processes, including make-to-stock and make-to-order production, work order execution, backflushing, inventory accuracy, and warehouse and material handling.

• Demonstrated functional solution and platform design capability, with the judgment to translate business needs into scalable, standardized Oracle capabilities rather than unnecessary customization.

• Ability to troubleshoot complex Oracle issues and perform root cause analysis across configuration, data, and integrated processes.

• Working understanding of integrations between Oracle Fusion and connected shop floor, warehouse, and planning systems.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain Oracle capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs to business and technical audiences across global teams.

• Ability to mentor and elevate less experienced analysts through knowledge sharing and solution design review.

• Experience supporting discrete, high-volume manufacturing operations.

title: Sr. Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Sr Manufacturing Engineer 1st shift Monday- Friday 7:00 AM-4:00 PM

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success.

We are an inclusive workplace that encourages diversity of thought, experience, and background to solve complex problems as one team. Every employee is encouraged to continuously improve and grow, and it is a top priority for managers to develop their teams, making a wide range of internal development opportunities available to all employees.

We are One Team, overcoming obstacles together and celebrating together. Come be part of a winning team that feels like family.

Your Role on Our Team:

The Senior Manufacturing Engineer serves as a technical and operational leader responsible for setting direction and driving the development and deployment of production build requirements, pallet display designs, operating instructions, and prototype builds for special-execution programs within Kitting and Manufacturing. This role leads the organization toward a culture of waste elimination by identifying opportunities, establishing improvement priorities, and mobilizing cross-functional teams to achieve an optimal future state, enhance the customer experience, reduce cost, and streamline operations. The Senior Manufacturing Engineer independently leads multiple moderate-to-highly complex and under-defined initiatives, makes sound technical and business decisions with minimal oversight, and remains accountable for sustainable results.

This position is a key leadership role within a cross-functional team operating in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will provide big-picture vision, translate business needs into clear technical priorities, and lead problem solving, process improvement, and change-management efforts across operations, IT, supply planning, marketing, finance, and sales. The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to build alignment, coach and develop engineering and operational partners, challenge existing practices constructively, and influence teams across departments and locations to make decisions and deliver results with minimal direction. Unlike an Engineer II, who typically executes defined work within an established scope, this role defines the path forward for ambiguous assignments, establishes standards, anticipates and mitigates risk, and is accountable for broader team and business outcomes.

Sr. Manufacturing Engineer
Job Duties

• Serve as a technical and operational leader for the manufacturing engineering function. Set direction, demonstrate ownership, lead through influence, mentor and coach less-experienced engineers, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive decisions through implementation with minimal oversight.

• Independently defines the path forward for complex or ambiguous work, anticipates business and operational risks, establishes technical standards, delegates and coordinates work as appropriate, and is accountable for team-level outcomes

• Work cross-functionally with channel, packaging engineering, customer supply chain, Ops Supply chain, and operations teams to ensure the design of pallet display meets customer requirements, distribution dimension requirements and Operations capabilities. The individual will leverage Tops Load Max Pro software to display the displays.

• Lead projects by working with cross functional resources to develop and implement new manufacturing processes and automated solutions.

• Manage the Oracle item structure (Bill of materials) set up and all changes in the Oracle system. Additionally coordinating with supply planning teams for changes with transition builds.

• Execute all the training & protype builds with operations leads and sign off process

• Create design and update operational method sheets (OMS) and related documentation and ensure they are current, accurate, and understood by the team.

• Manage the creation of Oracle work definition which includes defining the operations, resource, rates and integration with the item structure into the operations

• Drive improvements projects with Operations team to reduce cycle time in the manufacturing process contributing to the operational excellence. Implement all the rate improvements into the Oracle work definition

• Support production operations through troubleshooting problems

• Conduct statistical process control to define problems and present quick, applicable solutions to key stakeholders to implement change. Analyze information and data to determine a business case for manufacturing operations.

• Collaborate with integrators to develop solutions for manufacturing processes.

• Complete assigned operations projects within budgetary and scheduling guidelines.

• Track project schedule to ensure adherence to timelines.

• Consistently visualize entire scope of a project with minimal guidance.

• Identify project risks and implement risk reduction plans.

• Participate in Kaizen and project engineering activities within the facility.

Master’s or equivalent degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related engineering field, and 2 years of relevant manufacturing processes experience as an Engineer or related; OR Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related engineering field, and 5 years of relevant manufacturing processes experience as an Engineer or related.

Experience must include:

• Understanding of ERP

• Previous facilitator/coaching exposure/project participation where problem solving, process development and/or behavior change methods and tools have been used

• Ability to manage multiple concurrent project teams with time constraints

• Must have oral and written communications skills for presentations to all levels management

• Visio or similar application for process flow documentation

Preferred Qualifications:

• Tops Load Max Pro

• Lean Six Sigma Training

• Proficiency in project management tools or project management certification

• Oracle software

• Computer aided design (Unigraphics, SolidWorks, NX, or AutoCad).

• Managing multiple continuous improvement projects in a manufacturing setting.

• Lean principles (Value Stream Mapping and Kaizen).

• Data Analysis (Minitab, Pareto, Control charts, Microsoft Project, PowerBI, PowerPivot, or VBA).

Collaboration, Mentorship & Stakeholder Engagement

• Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Solid understanding of network security principles, segmentation, and best practices.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including leading Root Cause Analysis.

Generous 401 (K) savings plan

Education assistance

description:
Job Description:

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

Design Engineer – Batteries and Chargers

The Design Engineer’s primary role uses mechanical engineering expertise to contribute to the design and development of new products and support of existing products within the department.

About Us

Milwaukee is an industry-leading manufacturer and marketer of heavy-duty, portable electric power tools, accessories and hand tools for professional users worldwide. Since its founding in 1924, Milwaukee has focused on a single vision: To produce the best heavy-duty electric power tools and accessories available to the professional user. Today, the Milwaukee name stands for the highest quality, most durable and most reliable professional tools money can buy. Milwaukee currently employs approximately 1,500 people globally. The company continues to set industry standards, targeting professional tool users of all types with a product line that includes more than 500 tools, 3,500 accessories and 200 hand tools. Throughout its history Milwaukee's commitment to quality has remained steadfast. Quality is instilled using state-of-the-art technologies and sophisticated manufacturing techniques.

Day in the Life

As a Design Engineer for Milwaukee you will be located at our Brookfield, WI office. Our corporate office is only 15 minutes from downtown Milwaukee and located near American Family Field, Milwaukee Zoo, Mitchell Park Domes, as well as many more attractions and restaurants. You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products as a member of a cross-functional team. One of the most rewarding aspects of the job is seeing a product you designed on the shelves of a Home Depot.

If you are interested in travel, domestic and international travel opportunities are available and sometimes required. In the US, Milwaukee Tool has three locations in Mississippi (two manufacturing and one distribution). Overseas, you will have the opportunity to work with Chinese engineering counterparts as well as meet with suppliers in Vietnam, Taiwan, and China.

Milwaukee offers benefits on your first day of work including health, dental, vision, life insurance and 401k. Milwaukee also provides an excellent working environment that includes an on-site cafeteria, state of the art fitness facility, recreational sports leagues and company outings.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Take a concept idea and make it come to life.

• Design and test products from concept to production.

• Develop design solutions to meet consumer requirements.

• Participate in field research.

• Facilitate project flow involving regular contact with manufacturing and other cross-functional team members.

• Interact with suppliers to develop part/product specifications that meet performance requirements while falling within process capabilities.

• Evaluate product design relative to material selection, cost and reliability.

• Perform a wide variety of calculations and software aided analyses in the following areas:

• Mechanical stress analysis, material and heat treatment selection, tolerance and fit analyses, statics and dynamics, noise and vibration, thermal heat transfer, and a variety of machine element design.

• Independently develop, write, and analyze test requests with the Milwaukee Tool Test Laboratory.

• Work as a technical resource to troubleshoot problems with manufacturing teams and suppliers.

Education and Experience Requirements

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering; or similar field.

• 2+ years of experience in related design field.

• GD&T and CAD proficiency

• Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude.

• High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel and Power Point.

• Willingness to learn skill sets outside primary discipline.

• Ability to travel 10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International).

• High interest in tools of the trade.

title: Financial Systems Analyst II
description:
Job Description:

Your Role on Our Team:

Milwaukee Tool is seeking a Financial Systems Analyst to administer and improve the platforms, data processes, and controls supporting financial planning, reporting, allocations, and decision support. The role emphasizes system reliability, secure access, accurate data, user support, testing, documentation, and process automation. Finance knowledge provides valuable business context, but the primary focus is enterprise system administration and continuous improvement.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

System Administration & Support

• Administer the Milwaukee Tool EPM solution, including access, security roles, workflows, metadata, dimensions, hierarchies, forms, reports, and allocations.

• Monitor recurring processes, troubleshoot failures, coordinate resolution, and communicate impacts.

• Provide functional user support, document root causes, and escalate technical defects when appropriate.

• Support upgrades, patches, releases, regression testing, and environment readiness.

Data, Integrations & Controls

• Support data loads, mappings, interfaces, validations, reconciliations, and outbound reporting processes.

• Execute and validate recurring data and allocation processes for completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.

• Develop control checks, exception reporting, and audit documentation that strengthen data integrity.

Process Improvement & Partnership

• Identify manual or error-prone activities and recommend standardized, automated, or system-enabled alternatives.

• Use root-cause analysis to reduce recurring issues, risk, and cycle time.

• Partner with Finance, Accounting, IT, data teams, and vendors to deliver reliable, supportable solutions.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 2-4 years supporting enterprise applications, business systems, data processes, or reporting platforms.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, documentation, and communication skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including strong Excel capability, and ability to collaborate across functions.

The TOOLS we prefer you have:

• Experience with an enterprise performance management, planning, consolidation, or reporting platform.

• Experience with security, metadata, workflows, reports, allocations, or financial data models.

• Familiarity with integrations, SQL, APIs, ETL, scripting, workflow automation, testing, ticketing, or agile tools.

• Working knowledge of planning, management reporting, month-end processes, and internal controls.

Capabilities for Success

Systems thinking | Structured problem solving | Customer focus | Technical curiosity | Change discipline | Ownership | Continuous improvement

• Success is reflected in reliable recurring processes, secure and accurate system configuration, timely issue resolution, well-tested enhancements, reduced manual effort, and strong stakeholder adoption.

On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service

title: Sr. Project Engineer - Systems, Reliability and Test
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.  Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Senior Project Engineer will utilize advanced test development and analysis skills to contribute to the development and qualification of power tool products. This is a hands-on position where the candidate will be required to gain an understanding in the usage and operation of the tools/equipment under development.  Throughout a product's development cycle, this position requires strong cross-functional communication, requirements management, data analytics, and hands-on failure analysis to help launch new and exciting solutions that meet user needs. This is a fast-paced environment full of opportunities for innovation in new product test methods.  The senior engineer will also mentor and support less experienced engineers in technical development.

Duties and Responsibilities

•
Act as subject matter expert with respect to product testing, reliability, requirements management and warranty analysis for new product designs and engineering changes

•
Collaborate with design engineers and marketing to define the product specifications with respect to product life, durability, quality, and user needs

•
Participate in, and conduct, design reviews to showcase project status, risks, and system readiness for testing and verification activities

•
Develop and execute reliability, design, and validation assessments to support successful product introductions based on data driven evidence

•
Responsible for ensuring completion of product qualification test plans, including functional, reliability, and durability testing

•
Develop test procedures and prove out test methods based on new or established product designs to ensure power tools meet customer requirements

•
Analyze and present product usage and risk assessments utilizing statistical techniques such as Weibull analysis, reliability distributions and stress-strength analysis

•
Ensure timely failure reporting and perform root cause analysis for issues observed in life testing and/or field use

•
Occasionally join end user research events to identify "critical to quality" (CtQ) requirements on mechanical and electrical design features

•
Interact with global engineers, suppliers and manufacturing that participate in product commercialization

•
Track and support multiple projects simultaneously to ensure adherence to schedule and the Milwaukee Tool process

Qualifications

•
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, systems, robotics or other related engineering field

•
5 or more years of experience in product development, systems, reliability, test or similar function

•
Experience including systems engineering fundamentals, requirements management and proven ability to lead a primary function within a project team

•
Background in test development, verification, data collection and analytics.  Experience with HALT and other reliability test methods a plus

•
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and sound statistical application in areas such as Design of Experiments, sampling techniques, regression, reliability, FMEA, hypothesis testing, etc.

•
Experience with life data analysis, reliability distributions, and related software is a plus (e.g. Minitab, Reliasoft Weibull++)

•
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence at all levels with creative problem-solving capabilities.

•
Demonstrates excellent organizational skills and ability to support multiple projects simultaneously

•
Knowledge / Experience with the phases of residential and commercial construction as well as equipment usage is a plus

•
Ability to travel 5-10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International)

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

description:

Milwaukee Tool’s service experience is a customer expectation and a competitive advantage.  The Assistant Mgr, Service NPD combines strong technical, project management, and cross-functional organizational skills to ensure that products in his/her portfolio are ready to be serviced upon their launch and remain “service-ready” throughout their lifecycle.  Working constantly with product engineering, marketing, international manufacturing, finance, and quality, as well as Service functions like spare parts, technical literature, and service center engineering, this role leads the execution of service-readiness in Service centers, branches, and authorized service centers, and also supports service readiness in global regions.

In addition to actual product projects, the Assistant Mgr, Service NPD helps create, implement, and improve the tools and processes needed to perform its functions. This job description lists major areas of responsibility.  Additional job duties and objectives may change with the business.

Duties & Responsibilities

•
Create and own the global service-readiness plan, including key milestones and deadlines, to ensure products are service-ready across all customer touchpoints at launch.

•
Analyze sales forecasts, market trends, service demand, and regional business requirements to determine repair strategy recommendations by region.

•
Understand the underlying technology, service expectations, and competitive service landscape for existing and upcoming products in his/her portfolio.

•
Potential opportunities for exposure to new-to-Milwaukee and new-to-world products which would include creating all-new service programs and touchpoints.

•
Communicate and advocate for incorporating service needs into product designs.

•
Ensure readiness planning follows VIGOR and Service VIGOR, Milwaukee’s new product development standards.

•
Develop the repair and maintenance programs, including frequency, cost, complexity, and tooling and fixture needs.

•
Identify the spare parts and kits needed. Assist/guide the Tech Lit department in creating Spare Parts Lists. Assist planning and procurement departments in purchasing the correct spare parts in the right quantities at the right time, as needed.

•

title: Vibration Simulation & FEA Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

Vibration Simulation / FEA Engineer – Advanced Battery Simulation

We are seeking a Vibration Simulation / FEA Engineer to support the development and virtual validation of structures, mechanisms, and components for batteries. This role will focus on using finite element analysis (FEA), vibration simulation, modal analysis, and dynamic analysis to predict structural behavior, identify potential vibration and durability issues, wear, thermal fatigue, optimize designs, and improve product reliability.

The engineer will work closely with design, test, reliability, and product development teams throughout the product development cycle. The successful candidate will translate product requirements and real-world operating conditions into appropriate simulation models and loading criteria, correlate simulation results with physical test data, and provide actionable recommendations to improve product performance, durability, reliability, and cost.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

• Develop and execute FEA simulations for structural and vibration performance of components, assemblies, and complete systems.

• Perform modal analysis, including prediction and evaluation of natural frequencies, mode shapes, and structural resonance.

• Conduct dynamic simulations such as frequency response, harmonic response, random vibration, transient response, and shock analysis as applicable to product requirements.

• Evaluate structural response to operational vibration environments and identify potential resonance, amplification, fatigue, and durability concerns.

• Perform linear and nonlinear FEA to evaluate structural behavior under static and dynamic loading conditions.

• Develop appropriate finite element models, including mesh generation, material properties, boundary conditions, contacts, joints, and loading conditions.

• Define and apply vibration and structural loading criteria based on product requirements, customer usage, field data, and physical testing.

• Analyze vibration test data, including time-domain and frequency-domain data, to develop representative simulation inputs and validate analytical predictions.

• Support random vibration analysis, including interpretation and application of PSD-based loading where appropriate.

• Evaluate vibration-induced stresses and responses and perform fatigue and durability assessments using simulation results and measured operating data.

• Correlate simulation results with modal testing, shaker testing, field testing, and other physical validation data.

• Work closely with the test team to develop appropriate test methods, instrumentation strategies, excitation profiles, and performance criteria.

• Investigate discrepancies between simulation and physical test results and improve FEA models and assumptions to achieve meaningful correlation.

• Support troubleshooting of vibration, noise, structural, and durability issues identified during development and validation testing.

• Perform design optimization to improve structural stiffness, mass, natural frequency separation, durability, and overall product performance.

• Continuously improve simulation methods, modeling practices, and FEA/test correlation processes.

• Partner with design engineers to refine structural concepts and develop robust designs that meet performance, reliability, cost, and timing objectives.

• Develop, maintain, and release FEA models, vibration analysis reports, loading criteria, simulation methodologies, and technical documentation.

• Support product development teams in resolving structural and vibration issues while maintaining program development schedules.

• Assist with processing and interpretation of laboratory and field vibration data to establish realistic durability and loading criteria.

• Work closely with NPD (New Product Development), Test & Validation Engineering, Reliability & Durability Engineering, and Marketing.

• Communicate simulation results and engineering recommendations clearly to design and test teams.

• Work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional product development environment.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering

• 3+ years of Finite Element Analysis (FEA) experience

• 3+ years of prior work experience in design or product validation environment.

• doing mechanical design or validation, proficient in a CAD software package

• 3+ years of prior work experience in nonlinear FEA and fatigue analysis

• 3+ years of prior work experience with the following: Ansys, Abaqus and Abaqus Explicit FEA software, Hypermesh, and Optistruct software, Fatigue Software such as nCode, Mechanical principles, kinematics, structural materials, and standard machine and mechanism components.

• Knowledgeable in CAD – NX, Solidworks, or similar
