Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

title: Principal Power Electronics Engineer
description:
Job Description:

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.  Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

As a Principal Power Electonics Engineer on the Power Tool Technology team, you will investigate and develop new technologies and identify engineering trends to drive strategies and technical direction for Milwaukee Tool’s power tool and equipment businesses. You will work in a team environment interacting with cross-functional stakeholders to enable power tool solutions that change the lives of our users.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Apply expert knowledge of power semiconductors to drive system‑level tradeoff studies for motor drives and power conversion electronics, with strong emphasis on power density, signal integrity, EMI/EMC performance, and robustness in harsh, real‑world environments.

• Evaluate and investigate emerging technologies (devices, topologies and methods) to reduce risk and enable future product insertion aligned with business and product initiatives.

• Lead technology investigations encompassing system requirements definition, architecture development, and data‑driven technology assessment.

• Perform power loss, efficiency, thermal, and durability analyses to guide design decisions and assess technology readiness.

• Define, apply, and enforce EMI/EMC mitigation strategies and best practices for high‑power, high‑speed designs to ensure regulatory compliance and consistent performance.

• Interact with suppliers to understand their roadmaps and influence the design of components optimized to meet our performance needs and cost targets.

• Provide technical leadership through mentoring, design reviews and cross‑functional collaboration.

• Quickly, effectively, and candidly frame-up and escalate business risks/opportunities to senior leadership.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.

• 7+ years of experience designing motor drives and power electronics including switch mode power supply topologies, inverters, and semiconductor component selection.

• Expertise in modern brushless motor drive architectures and power conversion topologies, with the ability to execute power‑dense, component‑level designs.

• In‑depth knowledge of silicon and GaN power semiconductors, including device tradeoffs and application differences that enable efficient, high‑power designs.

• Firm understanding of magnetic circuit design including: Transformer design, gapped energy storage devices and filtering components.

• Proven ability to perform power loss analysis, efficiency optimization, and thermal design using appropriate analytical and simulation methods.

• Extensive hands‑on experience with motor drive and power supply system design tradeoffs, particularly related to signal integrity, noise, and robustness.

• Strong working knowledge of EMC/EMI concepts including identification of sources, transmission paths and mitigation methods effective in high‑power, high‑noise environments.

• Solid understanding of motor control fundamentals and control system design principles as they relate to motor drive hardware.

• Proficient with schematic capture, PCB layout, SPICE, and other simulation tools; applies industry best practices for power conversion PCB layout.

• Strong prototyping, debug, and root‑cause analysis skills, supported by effective use of lab instrumentation and measurement techniques.

• Hands-on approach with proven mechanical aptitude and ability to collaborate across electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing disciplines.

• Strong leadership experience.  Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, exercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment.

• Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international).

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering with focus in power electronics.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

• Education assistance.

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

• And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative- Glendale, AZ
description:
Job Description:

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

· Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

· Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

· Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

· Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

· Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

· Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

· Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

· Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

· Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

· Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

· Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

· Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

· Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

· Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

· Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

· Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

· Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

· Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

· Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

· Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

· Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

· Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

· Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

· The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Design of electronic, schematics, bill of materials, simulation, and analysis of power electronics circuits in power electronics devices and systems to meet technical product requirements.

• Execute deployment of the design electrical test, characterization, and validation of power electronics designs.

• Define technical methods and criteria for power electronics qualification procedures.

• Create requirements, specifications, and execution of circuit board layout, manufacturing requirements and process control metrics, and implementation processes of printed circuit board assemblies.

• Develop an optimized electrical, mechanical, and thermal solution utilizing balanced requirements to meet schedule, technical and cost constraints.

• Collaborate with and support other engineers, engineering competencies, suppliers, and partners to ensure proper development, execution, and verification of power electronics products.

• 2-5 years' relevant work experience

• Able to solve fundamental EE design circuits with ease (Read schematics, Circuits 1,2 Electronics 1,2)

• Basic proficiency with power electronics in the context of motor controls, power systems and technologies, and their regulatory requirements.

• Comfortable and capable of explaining technical issues to technical and non-technical audiences in email and in meetings

title: Sr. Advanced Mechanical Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Sr. Advanced Mechanical Engineer

Techtronic Industries, the world leader in cordless technology spanning Power Tools, Outdoor Power Equipment, Floor Care Appliances and Accessories is seeking a Sr. Advanced Mechanical Engineer for its Ryobi Outdoor Products Advanced Engineering team at our Innovation Center in Anderson, SC.

The Sr. Advanced Mechanical Engineer is a technical leader within the Advanced Engineering team, responsible for developing, analyzing, and maturing complex mechanical systems for next-generation tools. This role focuses on transforming early concepts and emerging technologies into robust, feasible mechanical solutions through advanced analysis, prototyping, and testing.

This position operates upstream of the traditional product development process with an emphasis on technical innovation and risk reduction. The Sr. Advanced Mechanical Engineer will lead mechanical design strategy using first-principles analysis, math models, and simulations, while also building prototypes and validate designs through testing to achieve product-ready solutions. The Advanced Engineering team is highly collaborative, deeply hands-on, and driven by curiosity and learning as we develop new and innovative outdoor products.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Lead advanced mechanical system design for next-generation outdoor products

• Own mechanical feasibility, performance validation, and technical risk reduction for advanced projects

• Develop and evaluate mechanisms, structures, and integrated systems using first-principles analysis, FEA, CFD, and physical testing

• Translate early concepts into technically mature designs suitable for transition into product development

• Build, test, and iterate functional prototypes to validate durability, performance, and manufacturability

• Define system requirements, user operation methods, and design trade-offs

• Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Industrial Design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure balanced technical solutions

• Guide junior engineers through complex mechanical design challenges and best practices

• Communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to engineering leadership and other stakeholders

• Contribute to budget, schedule, and quality planning to support key advanced engineering milestones

Qualifications:

• B.S. in Mechanical or related Engineering disciplines; advanced degree a plus

• 5+ years of experience in product advanced engineering, concept maturation, or innovation in consumer products, automotive, or adjacent industries

• Strong proficiency with 3D CAD (Solidworks, NX, etc.) and rapid prototyping

• Excellent mechanical design fundamentals with experience in mechanisms, gear design, structures, engineering materials, and manufacturing processes

• Proven track record of overseeing and evaluating the design of consumer products from start to finish is a major plus

• Experience building prototypes, developing test plans, and defining acceptance criteria

• Ability to couple first-principles analysis with advanced tools such as FEA, CFD, and AI/ML to guide mechanical design

• Ability to work on multiple projects in various stages of development simultaneously

• Work with a high degree of autonomy, leadership, and proactivity

• Experience with measurement equipment for vibration & sound is a plus

• Willingness to travel ~5-10% (domestic/international)

Software
MS Office, NX, SolidWorks, Ansys Mechanical, LS-Dyna, Fluent, Discovery, KISSsoft

We Value:

• Self-starters who can work well autonomously and in collaboration with teams

• Individuals with the “Maker” mindset – excited to jump into a new project and not afraid to get their hands dirty

• Collaborative contributors – bring outside experience and interests to brainstorming sessions

• Cross functional communicators - able to translate information between technical and non-technical co-workers

• Experience with Rapid Prototyping (varying materials and processes)

• Familiarity with electrical and mechanical systems (ex. motors, microcontrollers, batteries)

• Engineers who enjoy solving ambiguous technical problems and reducing uncertainty through data-driven design decisions

description:
Job Description:

Motor Engineer II

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in a mix of mechanical and electrical engineering expertise to design and develop leadership in motor capabilities. We create Best-in-Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive hands-on testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes, and cross-functional agility.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Motor Engineer II will collaborate with local cross-functional, Global Motor Engineering, and Operations teams to create and execute test plans to verify motor performance and thermal limits per project requirements. You will develop and apply a platform-based mindset to motor designs to ensure consistent and efficient mass-produced Milwaukee motors and products around the world.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

· Working independently to design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot motors for mid to high-level complexity projects.

· Work directly with external suppliers to research and investigate new technologies

· Directly support creation of, and drive a roadmap for motor technology

· Self-manage and track your projects, contributions of design, and test workflows to ensure project adherence to schedule and Milwaukee Tool’s processes Create test plans for motor components and assemblies within scope of the project.

· Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and data acquisition systems.

· Conduct hands-on experiments of power tools, perform simulations, and draw concise, logical conclusions by analyzing data.

· Perform root cause failure analysis on motor failures.

· Provide candid and effective communications up, down and across the organization on progress, barrier removal and escalation of business risks/opportunities.

· Role model Milwaukee Tool’s culture while providing technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching junior Engineers.

· Work with component suppliers and manufacturers for proper component selection on existing projects and providing input into future product needs.

· Schedule, develop agendas for, facilitate, and document technical meetings and formal presentations.

· Acquire knowledge and maintain an understanding of Milwaukee Tool’s development and manufacturing processes to effectively and efficiently mass produce power tools.

· Design and qualify new solutions to applicable regulatory standards such as UL, CEC, CE, and ANSI.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

· Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

· 2+ years of experience in a design related role.

· Familiarity with one or more of the following: Basic motor theory of Brushless and Brushed PMDC and AC motors; Electromagnetic analysis and motor design; Motor construction and assembly; Motor component design and manufacturing methods; FEA and CAD

· Excellent problem-solving skills, exercises independent judgement, and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment.

· Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic.

· Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international).

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

· Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field.

· Experience with motors in a related industry.

· Proficiency with FEA and/or CAD.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

· Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

· Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

· Education assistance.

· On-site wellness, fitness center, food and coffee service.

· And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

This role owns performance across D2C and marketplace channels and translates data into actionable insights, optimization plans, and growth strategies. This position partners closely with marketing, sales, product and finance teams to improve traffic, conversion, marketplace performance, and digital revenue outcomes. The role begins as an individual contributor with opportunity to scale scope and team responsibility as the business grows.

We are one of the largest floor care businesses in North America, owning three of the most iconic names in the industry—Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Oreck®. Each of these premier brands has a rich history that we’re building on every day here at TTI Floor Care, a subsidiary of Techtronic Industries Co., Ltd. We’re home to not only iconic brands but also the floor care industry’s most talented individuals developing and marketing new products through inspiration, insight, and dedication to quality and innovation.

D2C Performance Ownership: Own and optimize performance of the D2C e-commerce platform (Shopify), including conversion, average order value, traffic quality, and on-site merchandising.

Marketplace Growth: Lead strategy and execution across e-commerce marketplaces, including TikTok Shop and other marketplace platforms, driving listing optimization, content quality, discoverability, and conversion.

Social Commerce Expansion: Develop and execute growth strategies across TikTok marketplace and social commerce models, including testing, optimization, and scaling of winning approaches.

Analytics & Reporting: Analyze e-commerce, marketplace, and digital performance data using GA4, platform analytics, and reporting tools to deliver clear and actionable insights.

Insight Generation: Identify trends, performance drivers, and growth opportunities across channels and translate findings into execution plans.

Performance Marketing Support: Partner on SEM, SEO, and PPC strategies to improve traffic acquisition efficiency and conversion outcomes.

SEO & Site Optimization: Lead SEO and on-site optimization efforts across content structure, product pages, and technical elements to improve discoverability and conversion.

Testing & Optimization: Develop and manage testing roadmaps across landing pages, product detail pages, offers, and user journeys to improve funnel performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with brand, media, content, product, and finance teams to align e-commerce initiatives with business goals and campaign plans.

Measurement Frameworks: Help develop and refine e-commerce measurement frameworks and dashboards that connect channel metrics to revenue and profitability outcomes.

Roadmap Development: Build and maintain a prioritized e-commerce growth roadmap, identifying capability gaps, tools, and process improvements.

Performs other related duties as assigned.

CRITICAL SUCCESS FACTORS

Interpersonal Skills – ability to quickly establish rapport and credibility with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners.

Communication Skills – ability to clearly present performance results, insights, strategies, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

Technical Skills – demonstrates expertise in e-commerce platforms, marketplace tools, web analytics, SEO/SEM/PPC, and digital performance measurement.

Business Knowledge – strong understanding of D2C business models, marketplace economics, and digital revenue drivers.

Analytical Skills – ability to translate complex performance data into actionable insights and prioritized growth actions.

Execution Mindset – ability to operate hands-on, prioritize effectively, and drive measurable outcomes in a fast-growth environment.

• 5+ years of experience in e-commerce, D2C, or digital commerce performance roles

• Direct experience managing or optimizing Shopify or similar D2C platforms

• Experience with e-commerce marketplaces and social commerce platforms, including TikTok Shop preferred

• Working knowledge of GA4, SEO, SEM, and PPC performance marketing

• Experience turning analytics and performance data into actionable growth strategies

• Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; dashboard and visualization tools preferred

• Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimization preferred

• BS/BA degree preferred (Marketing, Analytics, Business, or related field)

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

• Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds at times.

title: Regulatory Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility. To learn more about the Milwaukee story and our company click HERE.

As a Regulatory Engineer for Milwaukee Tool, you will be located at our Corporate & Global Design Headquarter in Brookfield, WI. You will work in a fast-paced environment to define Regulatory Requirements as a member of a cross-functional design team. Under the direction of the Manager of Regulatory Compliance, you will work with other Regulatory Engineers with strong experience and background in this field.

Your primary duty is to assist in the coordination and execution of Regulatory and compliance testing and evaluation of Milwaukee products to the provisions of US, Canadian, and International product safety standards.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

•
Advise Project Leaders, Engineers, and Designers regarding safety requirements including tests and design constraints to minimize risk of injury and/or property damage.

•
Supervise all aspects of product safety certification for Milwaukee products sold worldwide. This includes, but is not limited to, preparation of test samples, execution of the test, test reporting and data analysis, and certification submittal.

•
Evaluate information and render opinion related to the safety and compliance of a concept, design, or product.

•
Conduct design reviews and construction reviews. Review test results and determine acceptability.

•
Work with technicians to troubleshoot test parameters and outcomes.

•
Communicate with product teams regarding product regulatory and safety matters.

•
Review and provide feedback for operator's manuals and on-product markings.

•
Establish and define best practices for fellow team members. Create tools to increase team efficiency.

•
Become conversant with the latest industry safety standards (UL, CSA, IEC, etc.), regulations (UN, IATA, FCC, CP65, RoHS, ErP, DOE, CEC, etc.), and OSHA specifications. Where requirements are unclear, assist in obtaining an interpretation from the appropriate authority.

•
Requires a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or technical equivalent

•
Experience handling product safety and regulatory activities, preferably associated with power tools, Lithium-ion batteries, lights, and/or consumer products, is desired.

•
High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel and Power Point.

•
Familiar with Hazard Based Analysis techniques.

•
Understanding of general laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, e-loads, and data acquisition systems.

•
Possess strong verbal, written and organizational skills essential to professional communication.

•
Show an emphasis on and adherence to schedule and attention to detail.

•
Ability to travel both domestically and internationally, as necessary.

•
High interest in tools of the trade.

•
Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

•
Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

•
Education assistance.

•
On-site wellness, fitness center, food and coffee service.

•
And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

title: Analytical Engineer III
description:
Job Description:

Primary Responsibilities:

• Support new product development (NPD) through CAE simulations, including CFD and FEA.  Responsibilities include axial and centrifugal fan design, internal flow path development, and structural integrity and durability.

• Support the Advanced Engineering team in the research and development of new to market products and technology.

• Perform and develop techniques for multi-physics simulations including conjugate heat transfer analysis, spray atomization, and aeroacoustics.

• Perform optimization and sensitivity analyses through design of experiments (DOE) and meta-modeling.

• Serve as subject matter expert in topics related CFD including RANS and scale resolving models.

• Develop reduced order plant models (ROM) to predict mechanical and thermal system performance using MATLAB, Simscape, Python, or similar languages.

• Perform measurements including sound, vibration, fan performance, vacuum performance, and pressure loss coefficients.

• Maintain current knowledge of developments in the field to recommend innovations to improve quality and effectiveness of company products.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical or Aerospace) or a related engineering field with 6+ years of relevant professional experience.

• Proficiency in CAD modeling (NX, SolidWorks or other commercial code).

• Proficiency in a computational language (MatLab, Simscape, Simulink, Python, Fortran, C, C++, or VB)

• Relevant work experience includes but is not limited to:

• Finite Element Analysis (FEA) or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulation

• Simulation of compressible and incompressible flow fields using RANS and scale resolving techniques.

• Multiphysics simulations including CHT, DPM, electromagnetics, aeroacoustics, and FSI

• Simulation of multi-phase flow fields

• System modeling in Matlab, Simscape, Simulink, Python, or other computational language

• Laboratory testing and data acquisition including but not limited to sound, vibration, temperature, pressure, flow rate, torque, power, etc.

• International and domestic travel not required

title: Metrology Technician - 2nd Shift
description:
Job Description:

Are you a fan of Milwaukee Tool products? Join us behind the scenes, and you'll be empowered every day to do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the field. You’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the tools industry to make it happen.

Our quality team is utilizing cutting edge metrology equipment to keep our innovative tools the market leaders in performance and reliability!

Being on the R&D side of the business means every task assigned to you may be different. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in manufacturing and inspection that allows them to become knowledgeable on all measurement equipment through internal and external training.

Your role on our team:

The Metrology Technician is a vital part of a growing Quality Metrology team. This team is responsible for accurate and timely data across the entire array of Milwaukee Tool products. What you’ll do goes beyond standard conformance inspection. This role provides ample opportunity to grow your career in various paths including reverse engineering and failure analysis!

Your duties and responsibilities:

•
Safely operate metrology equipment to generate requested data

•
Tactile bridge CMMs

•
Optical CMMs

•
Roughness & Contour Profilometer

•
Hand gages (micrometers, height gages, etc.)

•
Translate blueprints with advanced GD&T into measurement strategies

•
Communicate with engineers/requestors about their experimental intent

•
Record data through Excel and PowerPoint

•
Interact with requestors in-person or virtually to effectively present data

•
Adhere to all 5S and safety requirements in the work area.

The TOOLS you will need to bring with you:

•
7+ years of direct metrology experience

•
Prior experience with any CNC CMM, Zeiss Calypso preferred

•
Design and build work holding using modular fixture plates

•
Problem-solving skills and technical aptitude (e.g., have you built a computer, done car/home repairs, DIY remodeling, woodworking, 3D printing, etc.?)

•
3D spatial thinking

•
Understand coordinate systems and degrees of freedom

•
Visualize multiple-part assemblies

•
Experience with 3D view manipulation in software

•
Experience reading engineering drawings or assembly diagrams

•
Able to react to change effectively in a team setting and handle multiple tasks as assigned

Other TOOLS that are nice to have:

•
Degree or specialized training related to Inspection/Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering

•
AUKOM Certifications

•
Nondestructive Testing certification (ANST NDT)

•
Formal Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) training

•
Machining experience

•
3D modeling and CAD

Working conditions

Office Environment

•
Temperature controlled laboratory

•
Sometimes work within a few feet of other workers

Cultural values:

•
Teamwork: Works in team setting, aware of others, and can cover others when needed.

•
Leadership: Knows how to build consensus. Knows when to ask why.

•
Intellectual curiosity and humility: Interested in new individual and team challenges.

•
Focus and Execution: Can self-motivate and remain focused for high output.

•
Gritty & Agile: Stick with tough problems to drive solution, moves to the next problem quickly.

•
Deals with Ambiguity: Able to react to change effectively and handle other tasks as assigned.

•
Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans

•
Generous 401 (K) savings plan

•
Employee pricing for Milwaukee products

•
Education Assistance

•
Training and Career development opportunities

•
On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service

•
And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

description:

• Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic.

• Exceptional verbal and writing skills.

• Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international).

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• Experience with CAD tools, particularly those relevant to electrical/PCB design.

title: Engineering Manager - Value Engineering
description:
Job Description:

About TTI

Techtronic Industries Power Equipment, a subsidiary of TTI, has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for an Engineering Manager who will support our Value Engineering team and be responsible for developing engineering talent, driving cost reduction and product optimization initiatives, and delivering measurable business results across the Outdoor Power Equipment portfolio. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package including tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation, and holidays.

Primary Responsibilities

• Lead, develop, and mentor a team of engineers responsible for value engineering, cost reduction, product optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives across multiple product categories.

• Own the Value Engineering project portfolio, savings roadmap, forecasting, and annual financial objectives by prioritizing opportunities, allocating resources, validating savings, and driving execution against business goals.

• Identify and execute value engineering opportunities through product teardowns, benchmarking, design analysis, supplier collaboration, and manufacturing process improvements.

• Partner with Product Management, Global Engineering, Sourcing, Quality, Manufacturing, Finance, and Operations to implement solutions while maintaining product performance, quality, reliability, and user value.

• Lead technical and business tradeoff discussions related to cost, performance, quality, schedule, and manufacturing feasibility. Provide clear data-driven recommendations to leadership.

• Establish and maintain processes for opportunity identification, savings tracking, project execution, and status reporting.

• Ensure product changes, alternative materials, components, suppliers, and manufacturing processes are properly evaluated and validated through testing and engineering analysis.

• Communicate project status, realized savings, financial forecasts, risks, and resource needs to leadership while fostering a culture of total ownership, accountability, and one-team mentality.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 8 years, preferred 10 years of relevant engineering, product development, or technical project leadership experience.

• Minimum 2 years of experience leading projects, technical teams, or engineering personnel.

• Experience leading cost reduction, continuous improvement, or product development initiatives.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, product cost drivers, materials, supplier development, and engineering change management.

• Proven ability to lead engineering teams and influence cross functional stakeholders.

• Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to evaluate engineering decisions through both technical and commercial perspectives.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentation of technical and business recommendations to leadership.

• Ability to communicate effectively across global teams and international partners.

• Works with a sense of urgency, initiative, accountability, and ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with product teardowns, benchmarking, cost modeling, and designing for cost.

• Experience supporting global manufacturing operations and supplier networks.

• Demonstrated history of delivering measurable cost reduction and margin improvement initiatives.

• Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and balancing resources against aggressive business objectives.

Travel

• Up to 10% travel (international and domestic).

description:

title: Sr IAM Security Engineer
description:

We are looking for a Senior IAM Security Engineer to own, operate, and continuously improve our Saviynt-based Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex identity challenges, leading production support efforts, designing scalable integrations, and improving identity governance capabilities across the enterprise.

You will serve as the primary technical owner of our Saviynt implementation, ensuring reliable identity lifecycle management, access governance, and integration with enterprise systems including Oracle, Active Directory, Entra ID, and other critical business applications. This role balances hands-on engineering, operational ownership, governance maturity, and technical leadership.

Our IAM program is continuing to mature and expand. This role will play a critical part in improving platform reliability, reducing manual effort, strengthening governance controls, and enabling future identity initiatives and broader enterprise security capabilities.

Core Responsibilities:

Operate and Own IAM Services (Primary)

• Own day-to-day operation, support, and reliability of the Saviynt platform

• Troubleshoot and resolve provisioning, deprovisioning, reconciliation, and identity lifecycle failures across Oracle, Active Directory, Entra ID, and integrated applications

• Serve as the primary escalation point for IAM operational incidents and complex access issues

• Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective actions to prevent recurring issues

• Monitor platform health, job execution, provisioning success rates, and service performance

• Develop and maintain operational runbooks, support documentation, and knowledge articles

Advance Identity Governance Capabilities

• Support and improve Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) lifecycle processes

• Design, execute, and improve access certification campaigns and remediation activities

• Contribute to role-based and attribute-based access models (RBAC/ABAC)

• Support Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls, governance policies, and audit requirements

• Identify manual processes and develop automation solutions to improve efficiency and reliability

• Improve platform observability, monitoring, reporting, and operational metrics

• Develop dashboards and reporting that provide insight into platform health and governance effectiveness

• Improve testing practices, deployment processes, and operational maturity

• Contribute to IAM strategy, roadmap discussions, and future platform enhancements

• Assist with evaluation and adoption of new IAM technologies and capabilities

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in Identity and Access Management, Information Security, Platform Engineering, or related technical disciplines

• 3+ years of experience delivering Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) capabilities

• Experience administering and supporting enterprise IAM platforms such as Saviynt, SailPoint, Okta, EmpowerID, or similar technologies

• Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills in complex production environments

• Experience with identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, deprovisioning, and governance processes

• Experience developing or supporting integrations utilizing REST APIs, SOAP services, JDBC connections, or similar technologies

• Working knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, and enterprise authentication and authorization concepts

• Experience with scripting or development technologies such as JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, Java, or similar languages

• Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

description:
Job Description:

**Applicants must be authorized to work in the US; sponsorship is not available for this position

** This position is Hybrid onsite( NOT REMOTE)

WE CREATE EMPOWERED LEADERS!

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success, so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to provide technical solutions on our IT Team.

Our IT team is responsible for supporting our continued growth by partnering with each function to align the IT strategy and identify solutions, automating business processes, developing custom software solutions, providing and governing access to data, evaluating and implementing purchased software solutions, enabling advanced technologies like AI and ML, and managing the infrastructure and security these solutions require across the enterprise. We work to solve business challenges and drive efficiency through technology.

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Your Role on Our Team

The Agentic Automation Engineer is a multi-platform AI role at the Software Engineer I level. You will work with business-aligned teams, Product Owners, Architects, and senior Engineers to build and support AI agents and automations across more than one technology stack. Oracle knowledge is required; experience with Microsoft or other AI platforms is a nice to have.

Agentic AI is still a new discipline, so we do not expect you to arrive as an expert. You will learn multiple AI platforms hands-on by working with business-aligned teams and serving as a support escalation point for our production agents and automations, with ample opportunity to grow the depth of your expertise over time.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

• Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and automations, starting with Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications and expanding to Microsoft and other AI platforms as you grow.

• Partner with business-aligned delivery teams to understand their software development processes, identify tasks that are good candidates for agentic automation, and turn requirements into working solutions.

• Connect agents to enterprise systems and data using REST APIs, Oracle Integration Cloud, and platform connectors, following secure authentication and access practices.

• Serve as a support escalation point for AI agents and automations in production: troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and put fixes in place with guidance from senior engineers.

• Write and refine prompts, agent instructions, and tool definitions, and use testing and evaluations to improve the accuracy and reliability of agent responses.

• Monitor agent performance, usage, and the value each solution delivers, and recommend improvements based on what you learn.

• Follow responsible AI, security, and governance standards, including human approval steps, auditability, and data protection.

• Document solutions, support procedures, and reusable patterns so other teams can adopt them.

• Participate in agile ceremonies, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions, and stay current on emerging agentic AI capabilities across platforms.

• Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or another technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 1–3 years of experience in software development, automation, agentic development or an IT-related position; internships, co-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects count.

• Working knowledge of the Oracle technology stack, gained through work, internships, coursework, or certifications, such as Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, Oracle Integration Cloud, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

• Foundational understanding of generative AI and agentic concepts, including large language models, prompt design, retrieval and grounding, and tool or function calling.

• Programming or scripting experience in at least one language, such as Python, SQL, or JavaScript/TypeScript

• Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and common authentication methods such as OAuth 2.0.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the curiosity to learn new platforms quickly.

• Familiarity with agent interoperability standards, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A).

• Oracle or Microsoft AI certifications, for example Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications Foundations Associate.

• Strong professional, written, and verbal communication skills, and comfort working directly with business partners.

How you'll grow in this role

• Start on the Oracle platform: learn how our business-aligned teams use Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications and build your first agents alongside senior engineers.

• Expand across platforms by contributing to Microsoft and other AI solutions as needs evolve.

• Sharpen your troubleshooting and critical thinking skills through support escalation for the agents and automations we run in production.

• Deepen your expertise in the platforms and business processes critical to Milwaukee Tool, with room to grow along our Software Engineering career path.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans

• Generous 401 (K) savings plan

• Education assistance

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service · And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Job Description:

Automation Engineer 1

ABOUT TTI

Techtronic Industries is a fast-growing world leader in Power Tools, Accessories, Hand Tools, Outdoor Power Equipment, and Floor Care for Do-It-Yourself (DIY), professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, maintenance, construction, and infrastructure industries. The Company is committed to accelerating the transformation of these industries through superior environmentally friendly cordless technology. At TTI Anderson, our brands RYOBI and HART are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage and cordless product platforms of superior quality, outstanding performance, safety, productivity, and compelling innovation.

JOB SUMMARY

The Automation Engineer 1 supports Product Development and Engineering through designing and building test systems and automating product testing as a member of the Test Automation Group (TAG). Designing and developing mechanical mechanisms, generating mechanical assemblies (CAD), programming (PLCs, Robots, etc.), wiring, and debugging are the normal tasks that are done on a regular basis. An ideal candidate has a strong aptitude for developing mechanical and electrical solutions based on a given challenge or requirement.

RESPONSIBILITIES / SKILLS

MECHANICAL

• Design, assemble, and modify automated machinery to automate testing processes with guidance.

• Knowledgeable in 3D CAD software, Solidworks or NX preferred.

• Basic machining skills preferred.

• Mechanically inclined, strong problem-solving skills, hands-on individual.

ELECTRICAL

• Design, assemble, and modify electrical controls systems to automate testing processes with guidance.

• Proficient understanding of circuits/electronics.

• Proficient understanding of AC vs DC power electronics.

• Proficient understanding of sensors and actuators used in automation.

• Proficient in the use of typical lab equipment (multimeters, various instrumentation, power supplies, data acquisition systems, power analyzers, etc.).

SOFTWARE/PROGRAMMING

• Develop and debug automation programs (PLC, HMI, robotics, etc.) with guidance.

• Basic knowledge of LabVIEW, Allen-Bradley, and/or Mitsubishi PLCs and programming preferred.

• Basic knowledge of HMI programming preferred.

• Basic knowledge of Ignition or other SCADA preferred.

• Basic knowledge of GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, predictive analytics, prompt engineering, knowledge retrieval, or optimization is preferred.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT

• Demonstrated project management skills -- must be organized and pay excellent attention to detail.

• Routinely report project progress.

• Support coordination with other engineers to ensure design intent and cost effectiveness of test systems are achieved.

• Establish technical manuals, drawings, models, training documentation, and troubleshooting guides for newly established automated equipment/processes.

CULTURE IN PRACTICE

People First

• Treats teammates and managers with respect.

• Open to feedback and focuses on continuous personal improvement.

Total Ownership

• Takes responsibility for test system design and implementation.

• Ability to self-direct on projects and tasks.

Candid Communication

• Communicates system designs, ideas and problems clearly and effectively.

• Ability to write technical reports and documentation clearly.

Innovation Leaders

• Creative yet practical problem-solving and decision-making skills.

title: Lead Network Modeler
description:
Job Description:

The Lead Network Modeler will lead the development and application of network optimization models using commercial network modeling software to support strategic supply chain decisions. This is a hands-on role for an experienced network modeler with extensive experience building large, complex models and applying them to network design, greenfield analysis, and strategic network studies. The role combines deep modeling expertise with strong business acumen: understanding the decision to be made, determining the right level of model complexity, working through imperfect data, and translating results into actionable recommendations.

The Lead Network Modeler will work directly with business leaders and subject matter experts, help establish modeling best practices and priorities, and help build the organization's network modeling capability.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Build large, complex network optimization models using commercial network modeling software for network design, greenfield analysis, network optimization, distribution footprint, capacity, and other strategic studies.

• Translate business questions into modeling approaches that solve the actual business problem and support the decision - not simply the question as initially framed.

• Partner directly with key stakeholders and subject matter experts to understand objectives, requirements, constraints, tradeoffs, and decision criteria.

• Identify required stakeholders and data sources; gather, validate, and improve data; identify gaps; and work with business and technical partners to close them.

• Use sound judgment with imperfect data, distinguishing critical inputs from areas where reasonable assumptions or approximations are appropriate.

• Balance speed and precision - develop quick, directionally accurate models when appropriate while refining models when greater precision is required.

• Clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, methodology, results, and tradeoffs, and present recommendations to business stakeholders.

• Model complex supply chain economics and tradeoffs, including transportation, facility, labor, inventory, service, tax/duty, capacity, FTL/LTL, and shipment consolidation considerations.

• Challenge assumptions when appropriate and ensure models reflect the realities and economics of the business.

• Establish modeling best practices and help set priorities, coach others, and build broader network modeling capability.

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Analytics, or a related quantitative field required; Master’s degree preferred. Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

• Extensive hands-on experience using commercial network optimization/network design software to build large, complex supply chain models.

• Proven experience with platforms such as Coupa Supply Chain Guru, Cosmic Frog, or a comparable enterprise network optimization software.

• Experience independently building and executing complex network models - not simply consuming or supporting models built by others.

• Demonstrated experience with greenfield analysis, network design studies, and strategic network optimization.

• Strong supply chain network design knowledge and understanding of cost, service, capacity, inventory, transportation, and operational tradeoffs.

• Experience taking a business problem from definition through data gathering, model development, scenario analysis, interpretation, and recommendation.

• Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to work directly with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain assumptions and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.

• Ability to work independently in an ambiguous environment, prioritize competing needs, and drive work through completion.

• Passion for solving complex problems and using analytics to create meaningful business impact.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Experience modeling transportation costs and flows, including FTL, LTL, shipment consolidation, and/or multi-modal transportation.

• Experience incorporating labor, occupancy, handling, inventory, duties/tariffs, taxes, or other location-dependent costs into network models.

• Experience with large-scale supply chain datasets and data preparation/validation.

• Experience with SQL, Python, Databricks, or similar analytical technologies.

• Experience establishing reusable modeling frameworks or best practices and coaching other modelers.

Techtronic Industries North America, Inc. (TTI) is seeking a Internal Audit Senior reporting to the IA Manager. This position will be an addition to a growing team in the Techtronic Industries Florida office located in Downtown Fort Lauderdale, FL.  This role offers a strong development path with opportunities to take on increasing responsibility and progress within Internal Audit, as well as in other departments throughout the Global Organization. TTI Internal Audit is a global service function that plays a critical role in enhancing operations, strengthening the risk management environment, and adding value to the organization. The Internal Audit team delivers both assurance and consulting services with engagements related to all business processes. As a Senior Internal Auditor, you will lead a variety of engagements across key business processes, applying a broad skill set to evaluate operational and financial risks and drive practical improvements.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Executes the annual audit plan and proactively maintains the audit schedule. Always keeps management and team up to date on progress of engagements and communicates delays on time.

• Develops and executes audits from start to finish, including the engagement planning, fieldwork and reporting.

• Prepares and suggests to Manager the audit objectives, scope, and detailed audit programs based on risk analysis of the audited area.

• Suggests detailed audit procedures and analytics to satisfy defined audit objectives.

• Performs process walkthroughs; documents narratives/flowcharts as needed; tests design and operating effectiveness of controls.

• Leverages data analytics for full-population testing, trend analysis, and anomaly detection.

• Produces high quality workpapers in accordance with internal audit methodology and IIA Standards, which is clear, organized, accurate, complete, free of error and has appropriate attention to detail.

• Supervises, assists, mentors and reviews junior auditors’ work, as needed. Answers their questions and provides direction on how to complete assignments.

• Elevates potential issues timely after gathering key facts; leverages team members and appropriate resources to assist in resolution.

• Reviews and discusses audit findings internally, being able to explain gaps and/or process improvements identified clearly and factually and with the auditee including higher level management, as appropriate.

• Communicates general, complex, and technical information effectively and appropriately.

• Prepares clear, concise, and timely audit reports, as needed.

• Performs root-cause analysis, recommends appropriate corrective action to ensure that control standards are met, agrees action plans with owners, and tracks and validates remediation efforts.

• Maintains effective working relationships with management, external auditors and consultants.

• Assists in the development of audit strategies to ensure high quality, timely, risk focused and efficient internal audit services.

• Assists in the preparation and presentation of training materials to staff, as needed and is a point of contact and consultation for new hires.

• Presents ideas for improvements to the IA Department and collaborates with team and brainstorms ideas and solutions.

• Performs investigations and other tasks and projects as requested.

• Maintains independence and objectivity; handles sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

Technical Skills / Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance (MBA degree is desirable).

• A minimum of 2 years of experience in audit, accounting or finance departments. Operational audit experience or experience in manufacturing operations (including manufacturing/warehousing environments) strongly preferred.

• Big 4 public accounting experience a plus, serving manufacturing and/or warehousing clients and auditing operational processes a plus.

• Control testing experience, particularly inventory controls (e.g., receiving, inventory movements, cycle counts, physical inventory, standard costing), preferred.

• Internal audit experience (in-house/corporate IA) a plus.

• Experience with audit management tools (Teammate/AuditBoard (Optro)) a plus.

• Experience working with large data and performing data analytics a must. Knowledge of data analytics tools (e.g., ACL, Tableau, Power BI) a plus.

• Knowledge of internal control and risk frameworks (COSO) and the IIA/Global Internal Audit Standards, IFRS, and GAAS plus.

• CIA and/or CISA certification a plus or willing to get certified in a year since hire date.

• Active CPA License is a plus.

• Candidate must live in / relocate to Fort Lauderdale, FL. This position is based on site at our Fort Lauderdale, FL office, 4 days per week in-office.

• Approximately 20-35% travel (trips typically do not exceed a one-week period)

Soft Skills:

• Must be passionate and have a drive for excellence and continuous improvement.

• Curious in nature and detail oriented.

• Excellent communication and inter-personal skills; ability to work cross-functionally at all levels, especially in challenging circumstances in which business owners may not agree with observations.

• Strong time and project management experience- strong ability to prioritize and multi-task. Agility a must.

• Strong report writing and presentations skills with clear logic and critical thinking demonstrated.

The primary responsibility of the Manager, Design Engineering – Battery Modeling is to build and lead a simulation team that guides the design, development, validation, and delivery of high-power-density lithium-ion battery packs. This role combines people leadership, advanced modeling and simulation expertise, technical strategy, and project portfolio management to improve product performance, safety, reliability, cost, and development speed.

• Design of Experiments, optimization, and parametric studies

• Statistical data analysis, model calibration, and simulation-to-test correlation

description:
Job Description:

Are You Ready to Lead Through Change?

You will lead a team of trade compliance professionals responsible for enabling global growth while ensuring compliance with import, export, customs, sanctions, and trade regulations worldwide.

You will act as the operational and strategic bridge between executive leadership and front-line execution, transforming business priorities into actionable plans, removing obstacles, and enabling your team to perform at the highest level. This role requires a leader who can make informed decisions quickly, navigate ambiguity, develop talent, and drive measurable business outcomes.

This position reports to the VP, Global Trade Compliance.

Job Description

Milwaukee Tool continues to expand globally, creating new opportunities and increasing complexity across supply chains, regulatory environments, and international markets.

As the Senior Manager, Global Trade Compliance, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping and executing the organization's trade compliance strategy while ensuring operational excellence across a rapidly evolving business.

You will oversee trade compliance programs, regulatory initiatives, customs compliance activities, systems governance, operational analytics, and team development. Working closely with Supply Chain, Sourcing, Logistics, Legal, Finance, Operations, Customer Care, IT, and executive leadership, you will ensure compliance objectives are achieved while enabling business growth and operational efficiency.

In addition to leading people and programs, this role will establish operational rigor through strong data management, systems ownership, structured documentation, and performance measurement. You will leverage metrics and analytics to help the department identify risks, monitor performance, improve processes, and support executive decision-making. Success requires the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights while building scalable processes that support Milwaukee Tool's continued growth.

Your Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, develop, and inspire a team of trade compliance professionals across multiple functional areas.

• Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability measures.

• Coach and develop team members through candid feedback, mentorship, and growth opportunities.

• Contributes to an environment that promotes cross-functional collaboration, ownership, urgency, collaboration, and continuous learning and improvement.

• Build organizational capability by developing future leaders within the Trade Compliance organization.

Trade Compliance Strategy & Execution

• Translate executive and organizational priorities into actionable initiatives and measurable results.

• Lead import and export compliance projects supporting Milwaukee Tool's global operations.

• Oversee customs compliance, tariff strategy, country of origin, valuation, free trade agreements, duty mitigation programs, and related trade initiatives.

• Monitor, assess, and implement regulatory changes impacting global trade operations.

• Partner with business leaders to support sourcing initiatives, new product introductions, acquisitions, market expansions, and supply chain transformations.

• Evaluate compliance risks and recommend practical business solutions that balance risk mitigation and operational efficiency.

Operational Excellence, Analytics & Documentation

• Identify, coordinate, provide guidance, and continuously improve trade compliance KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and executive reporting.

• Establish and provide guidance to the team on structured documentation practices including SOPs, work instructions, process maps, governance frameworks, and decision-making guides.

• Identify and coordinate the creation of performance metrics that provide visibility into team effectiveness, compliance health, service levels, and business impact.

• Analyze trade, customs, operational, and process data to identify risks, trends, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.

• Support Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, and business stakeholders through reporting, analytics, data validation, data review, and performance measurement.

• Provide meaningful insights and recommendations that enable business teams to make informed decisions.

• Drive data integrity, governance, and quality across trade compliance systems and reporting tools.

• Facilitate structured documentation, metrics management, and operational reviews that improve consistency, scalability, and accountability.

• Ensure trade compliance programs are supported by measurable performance objectives and clearly documented processes.

Systems & Technology Leadership

• Serve as the business owner and champion for Global Trade Management and related compliance technologies.

• Partner with internal trade team, IT and business stakeholders to prioritize system enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Evaluate opportunities to automate processes and leverage technology to increase efficiency and compliance effectiveness.

• Support development of reporting capabilities, analytics tools, workflow automation, and business intelligence solutions.

• Ensure trade compliance systems effectively support business growth, compliance requirements, and operational scalability.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Supply Chain, Sourcing, Logistics, Operations, Finance, Customer Care, Legal, and IT.

• Partner with business stakeholders to solve complex trade compliance and operational challenges.

• Collaborate with customs brokers, consultants, outside counsel, and regulatory authorities as needed.

• Communicate complex regulatory and business issues clearly to both executive and operational audiences.

Regulatory & Compliance Governance

• Ensure compliance with U.S. and global import and export regulations.

• Maintain effective compliance controls, recordkeeping requirements, and governance procedures.

• Lead audit preparation, regulatory inquiries, disclosures, corrective actions, and remediation efforts.

• Drive a culture of proactive compliance while supporting business objectives and operational needs.

• Ensure programs remain aligned with evolving regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

You will have:

• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain, International Trade, Law, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in trade compliance, customs, global trade, logistics, international business, or related regulatory functions.

• 5+ years of experience leading and developing professional teams.

• Demonstrated success leading through organizational growth, change, and ambiguity.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. customs regulations, import compliance, export controls, sanctions, and global trade requirements.

• Experience utilizing metrics, analytics, and reporting to drive operational performance and business decisions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex concepts into actionable guidance.

• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. Milwaukee Tool will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this position.

Preferred:

• Licensed Customs Broker (LCB).

• Advanced degree in International Business, Law, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or related field.

• Experience managing customs and regulatory communications, including audits, inquiries, disclosures or other government interactions as needed.

• Deep understanding of tariff programs, country of origin analysis, customs valuation, and free trade agreements including USMCA.

• Experience overseeing implementation or managing Global Trade Management (GTM) systems and trade compliance technology solutions.

• Strong analytical capabilities, including overseeing and assisting with development of KPIs, dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting.

• Strong understanding of how business processes translate into system functionality, data flows, reporting requirements, and automation opportunities, including an awareness of system capabilities and limitations.

• Experience establishing governance frameworks, documentation standards, and scalable business processes.

• Proven track record of using data to drive operational improvements and support strategic decision-making.

• Strong project management, organizational leadership, and change management capabilities.

• Experience supporting multinational operations and global compliance programs.

Primary duties are to lead and direct the advanced quality and reliability activities of project teams to successfully meet Project Quality/Reliability Objectives as well as project goals including Supplier Development, Time-To-Market, Cost, and Performance. The primary duty of this position is to serve as a Quality & Reliability expert to the business and projects teams, with minimal supervision.  Should be able to demonstrate strong problem-solving & critical thinking skills and show proactiveness in executing deliverables.

Administration Responsibilities:

• Work with global teams in Asia and Mexico to execute NPD, Product Support, and Value Engineering projects.  Up to 20% travel is required.

• Serve as the representative to the Accessories Quality & Reliability team on NPD teams alongside Marketing and Engineering counterparts.  Effectively capture and communicate risk and lead alignment towards mitigation and closure.

• Research, develop and revise Quality Policies, Procedures, System Instructions, Engineering Standards and Work Instructions that govern the operations of the Quality Engineering Department and Quality-related activities of the Corporate Office and the Manufacturing Facility.

• Establish and maintain a framework and systems for collecting and analyzing product performance, statistical process control, conducting gauge repeatability and reproducibility studies.  Write standards and procedures governing the conduct of these activities including the data to be collected, reporting methods, etc.

• Formally lead and capture Supplier Development activities for all NPD projects to ensure stable processes and the manufacturing quality products in a mass production setting.

Quality Engineering Responsibilities (60%):

• Work with the global quality teams to develop QC mitigation strategies for high-risk specifications.

• Coordinate quality planning activities such as auditing, inspection, and control plans (incoming, in-process and outgoing) that drive user need CtQ requirements through product specifications and into manufacturing processes.

• Collaborate with US, European, and Asian-based manufacturing and supplier representatives to ensure operational readiness of new product launches.

• Ensure manufacturing process stability and capability through the use of advanced statistical methods; including Six Sigma methods, and Ppk and Cpk analysis and interpretation.

• Use advanced statistical analysis to recommend process improvements and value engineering ideas.

• Participate in the evaluation and selection of suppliers.

• Able to call, lead and conduct global, cross-functional team members with the following participants: New product development engineering, internal/external operations/suppliers, quality, and supply chain.

• Provide technical guidance to the PRC and US-based supplier quality teams.

• Identify and work on process improvement opportunities within the Quality/Reliability Department, beyond the core project teams.

• Monitor, investigate, and report field product reviews, utilizing various user feedback data streams to determine overall product health and assess risk of product quality.

Reliability Engineering Responsibilities (40%):

• Collaborate with Engineering and Marketing to translate customer needs into product requirements and specifications.

• Support the product design process including benchmarking and testing of concepts & prototypes.

• Develop and execute test procedures to validate product specifications and ensure Quality and Reliability readiness.

• Lead Risk Assessments (Design and Manufacturing) during the product development cycle.

• Perform reliability analysis, using advanced statistical techniques including Weibull, ANOVA, and other statistical tools.

• Interpret and present advanced statistical data to a cross-functional team in a concise format.

• Perform failure analysis, and recommend solutions with corrective action, as required.

• Proactively seek out quality improvements for new and existing products.

Education and Experience Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent field, plus 5 years of related work experience

• Strong background in statistical analysis and methodologies

• Working knowledge of quality/reliability applications such as Minitab and ReliaSoft

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, specifically Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

• Nice to have experience:  Six Sigma, Auditing, Plant Quality, PowerBI, Test Development
