title: Project Engineer 1 - Value Engineering
description:
Job Description:

The Project Engineer I supports the cross-functional initiatives focused on cost reduction, product optimization, and continuous improvement for TTI Engineering. Working under the guidance of experienced project leaders and engineering leadership, this role helps translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, maintains project plans and risk visibility, coordinates technical deliverables, and supports products from concept through production. The Project Engineer I develops project leadership capability while building strong technical judgment, communication, and accountability.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Project Scope & Requirements

• Supports development and maintenance of product requirements, engineering specifications, and critical-to-quality (CTQ) measures for assigned projects.

• Helps identify where requirements create challenges to cost, performance, quality, or schedule.

• Supports product teardowns to drive new cost down ideas.

• Supports scoping of assigned systems, subsystems, and project deliverables with guidance from senior project leadership.

• Documents decisions, assumptions, open questions, and changes to project scope.

Schedule, Risk & Execution

• Develops and maintains work breakdown structures, action trackers, milestone plans, and project documentation for lower-complexity projects or defined workstreams.

• Tracks deliverables, identifies emerging schedule threats, and escalates issues when support or cross-functional alignment is needed.

• Supports project risk reviews by documenting likelihood, impact, mitigation actions, owners, and closure evidence.

• Coordinates prototype builds, testing, design reviews, pilot builds, and release activities with functional owners.

• Demonstrates consistent follow-through and personal accountability for assigned actions.

Cost, Quality & Product Performance

• Supports product cost tracking, competitive benchmarking, design trade-off analysis, and value engineering activities.

• Works with Design Engineering, Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Compliance, Reliability, and suppliers to resolve project issues.

• Uses data from testing, builds, and supplier feedback to help the team evaluate options and make informed decisions.

• Supports compliance with internal standards and applicable UL, ANSI, CSA, and ISO expectations.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication

• Facilitates routine project meetings or defined agenda sections with coaching; records decisions, owners, and due dates.

• Communicates project information clearly through written updates, presentations, and action summaries.

• Builds productive relationships with domestic and global team members and actively incorporates input from others.

• Proactively communicates obstacles and seeks help early enough to protect project commitments.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in engineering, product development, manufacturing, or project work; internships and co-op assignments count toward this requirement.

• Working knowledge of engineering fundamentals, drawings, product testing, and structured problem solving.

• Ability to organize technical information, maintain action trackers, and communicate clearly across functions.

• Strong analytical, planning, and follow-through skills.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, consumer products, or electromechanical systems.

• Familiarity with cost reduction strategies, DFMEA, CTQ development, and design verification.

• Fundamental knowledge of SolidWorks or other CAD software

• Experience supporting prototype or pilot builds and working with global suppliers.

• Basic proficiency with project scheduling, data analysis, and Microsoft Office tools.

Travel

• Up to 10% travel (international and domestic).

title: Design Engineer
description:
Job Description:

The Design Engineer I - Plastics supports the design, development, validation, and launch of injection molded plastic components and assemblies. This role is intended for an early-career engineer who can build foundational expertise across plastic part design, DFM/DFA, material selection, tooling considerations, molding processes, testing, and simulation-informed decision making.

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES

At Milwaukee Tool, our Engineering Teams develop innovative solutions that improve the productivity, safety, durability, and performance of products trusted by professional users every day.

As a Design Engineer I - Plastics, you will work within cross-functional product development teams to design and improve plastic components from early concept through production launch. The role provides hands-on exposure to plastic part design, materials, tooling, processing, manufacturing, testing, and injection molding simulation workflows.

This position is designed as a development role for an engineer interested in growing practical plastics expertise while contributing to high-impact product development work.

You'll Be DISRUPTIVE Through These Duties and Responsibilities

Product Design & Development

·       Design and develop plastic components and subassemblies for new product development and continuous improvement projects.

·       Create, maintain, and release 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

·       Apply DFM and DFA principles to improve product performance, manufacturability, quality, assembly efficiency, and cost.

·       Support design reviews, tolerance reviews, prototype builds, engineering builds, and production launch activities.

·       Collaborate with industrial design, product engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, quality, suppliers, and test teams throughout the product development process.

Plastics Engineering

·       Support material selection for thermoplastics, elastomers, and related polymer systems based on mechanical, cosmetic, environmental, regulatory, and manufacturing requirements.

·       Develop working knowledge of injection molding behavior, including gate location, flow length, shrinkage, warpage, weld lines, sink, knit lines, cooling, ejection, and parting line considerations.

·       Review and interpret injection molding simulation results, including Moldflow outputs, to support part design optimization, gating recommendations, filling performance, cooling strategy, and warpage reduction.

·       Partner with tooling engineers, molders, suppliers, and manufacturing teams to resolve molding-related design, tooling, and process concerns during prototype and production phases.

·       Assist with evaluation of new plastic materials, manufacturing methods, and design approaches for future product applications.

Testing, Validation & Problem Solving

·       Support engineering validation and verification testing for plastic components and assemblies.

·       Analyze test results, identify design risks, and implement design improvements based on data and engineering judgment.

·       Assist in troubleshooting plastic component failures, quality issues, and manufacturing concerns using structured root cause analysis methods.

·       Work with materials, quality, tooling, manufacturing, and supplier teams to identify corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

·       Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on product reliability, manufacturability, weight, cost, quality, and performance.

Project Execution & Communication

·       Support multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced product development environment.

·       Document engineering assumptions, test results, design decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly and accurately.

·       Communicate project status, technical risks, open issues, and design changes to project stakeholders in a timely and professional manner.

·       Participate in supplier discussions, design reviews, engineering builds, and cross-functional project meetings as required.

·       Build technical capability through mentorship, hands-on projects, training, supplier engagement, and collaboration with experienced plastics, tooling, materials, and simulation resources.

What TOOLS You'll Bring With You

Required Qualifications

·       Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Plastics Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related technical discipline.

·       0-3 years of engineering experience, including internships, co-ops, or relevant project experience.

·       Basic understanding of plastic materials and injection molding processes.

·       Experience using 3D CAD software such as NX, Creo, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar platforms.

·       Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

·       Interest in hands-on product development, testing, manufacturing, and root cause analysis.

·       Ability to work effectively in cross-functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

·       Coursework, internship, co-op, or project experience involving plastics, injection molding, tooling, or manufacturing processes.

·       Exposure to Moldflow, Moldex3D, Sigmasoft, SolidWorks Plastics, Autodesk Moldflow Adviser, or similar injection molding simulation tools.

·       Understanding of DFM principles for injection molded plastic components.

·       Familiarity with GD&T, tolerance analysis, and engineering drawing practices.

·       Exposure to FEA, mechanical testing, material testing, or data analysis.

·       Experience with rapid prototyping technologies such as 3D printing.

·       Knowledge of plastic material performance tradeoffs, including strength, impact, fatigue, creep, chemical resistance, cosmetics, cost, and manufacturability.

description:
Job Description:

Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Electrical Engineer 2 - Embedded Systems Hardware will design, develop, test, and validate MCU-based embedded hardware platforms, with a strong focus on circuit design, hardware bring-up, troubleshooting, and reference design delivery. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, systems, test, product development, architecture, and reliability engineers to solve hardware and system-level challenges. Working knowledge of embedded firmware will enable effective MCU configuration, hardware validation, and HW/FW integration and debugging.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Actively contribute as hardware electrical engineer in a multi-disciplinary team of engineers designing, prototyping, testing, troubleshooting and documenting of embedded electronics platforms.

• You will design, prototype, test, troubleshoot, and document embedded electronics platforms as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team.

• Develop embedded hardware from concept and schematic through bring-up, validation, and documentation, including test plans, procedures, and test cases.

• Design and validate MCU interface circuitry, including analog and digital signal conditioning, filtering, communication interfaces, control circuits, and protection circuitry.

• Understand and troubleshoot MCU peripherals and interfaces, including GPIO, timers, ADCs, and communication peripherals, while partnering closely with firmware engineers.

• Independently troubleshoot embedded hardware and system-level interactions, using hardware modifications and embedded firmware as needed to isolate root cause.

• Evaluate critical electronic components, perform technical tradeoff analyses, and recommend design or requirement changes based on performance, cost, risk, and project needs.

• Apply engineering best practices including circuit simulation, derating analysis, PCB design/layout, instrumentation, root-cause analysis, validation, and technical documentation.

• Own assigned deliverables against project schedules and work breakdown structures while proactively communicating technical risks, opportunities, recommendations, and required escalations.

• Collaborate effectively with hardware, firmware, systems, test, reliability, product-development teams, and external semiconductor/component suppliers.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering field, with approximately 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience.

• Strong fundamentals in analog and digital circuit design.

• Hands-on experience designing, bringing up, testing, and troubleshooting MCU-based embedded hardware.

• Proficiency using laboratory instrumentation including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.

• Experience with schematic capture and the PCB design/layout process using ECAD tools.

• Experience applying circuit simulation and engineering analysis to guide and validate hardware designs.

• Working knowledge of MCU peripherals including GPIO, timers, ADCs, and serial communication interfaces.

• Demonstrated ability to systematically troubleshoot hardware and perform root-cause analysis.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Experience performing PCB rework and circuit modifications to support prototype bring-up, debugging, and design validation.

• Experience using embedded C/C++ to configure MCU peripherals and support hardware bring-up, test, and troubleshooting.

• Experience supporting EMC/EMI testing, troubleshooting results, and implementing design improvements.

• Experience with embedded communication interfaces such as UART, I²C, SPI, USB, or CAN.

• Experience evaluating and selecting MCUs, sensors, analog devices, communication ICs, or other semiconductor components.

• Education assistance.

title: Recruiter
description:
Job Description:

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES!

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success - so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to get the job done, while providing a superior candidate and customer experience.

Our Talent team is committed to providing the support, tools, programs, and innovative technologies that allow our leaders to build inclusive, high-performing teams. We achieve this by partnering with leadership to create proactive talent solutions to optimize the organization’s short and long-term goals. Our focus on the employee experience enables us to attract, develop, engage, and retain people to their full potential.

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Your Role on Our Team

The Recruiter plays a critical role in driving end-to-end hiring outcomes across our Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, and other business functions. This role partners closely with hiring managers and Talent stakeholders to develop and execute targeted recruiting strategies, ensuring alignment to workforce needs and organizational priorities.

You will be viewed as a trusted advisor to the business, influencing hiring decisions, elevating talent strategies, and delivering a seamless, high-quality candidate experience. Through the use of data, market insights, and innovative sourcing approaches, you will continuously improve recruiting effectiveness, efficiency, and outcomes.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

Recruitment Strategy & Delivery

• Drive full-cycle recruitment for Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, and other business functions.

• Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, calibrate talent expectations, and develop targeted recruiting strategies.

• Source, screen, and advance candidates aligned to both technical requirements and company culture.

• Lead offer development and negotiations, ensuring alignment to internal equity, market data, and candidate expectations.

• Proactively pipeline talent, identify any potential risks, and adjust strategies to meet changing hiring demands.

Stakeholder Partnership & Influence

• Serve as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.

• Lead intake/scoping conversations to establish clear expectations, timelines, and success profiles.

• Facilitate alignment through consensus discussions and structured interview feedback.

• Partner cross-functionally within Talent (HR Business Partners, Talent Development, Total Rewards) to support hiring success.

• Influence hiring decisions through data, market insights, and candidate calibration.

Candidate Experience & Brand

• Deliver a high-quality, consistent candidate experience from initial outreach through offer acceptance.

• Set clear expectations and maintain proactive communication with candidates and hiring teams.

• Represent Milwaukee Tool’s brand through professional, engaging candidate interactions.

• Ensure a smooth, efficient, and transparent hiring process.

Data, Insights & Continuous Improvement

• Track and analyze recruiting metrics (e.g., pipeline conversion, time-to-fill, source effectiveness).

• Use data to identify trends, improve workflows, and drive better hiring outcomes.

• Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance speed, quality, and efficiency.

• Maintain compliance with all recruiting processes, documentation, and systems.

Functional & Technical Execution

• Leverage ATS (Workday) and sourcing platforms to manage pipelines and recruiting activity.

• Maintain accurate and compliant candidate records and recruiting documentation.

• Independently manage requisition workload with strong organization and prioritization.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you

• 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience

• Experience partnering with hiring managers on recruiting strategy and execution.

• Proven ability to manage multiple requisitions with efficiency and strong attention to detail.

• Strong sourcing skills across active and passive candidate markets.

• Ability to influence stakeholders and build strong cross-functional relationships.

• Experience using recruiting data to drive decisions and improve outcomes.

• Proficiency with ATS systems (Workday preferred) and sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, etc.).

• Strong written and verbal communication and organizational skills.

• This role is based out of our corporate headquarters in Brookfield, WI. Relocation is required.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Experience recruiting in a high-growth or fast-paced environment.

• Knowledge of employment laws, compliance standards, and recruiting best practices.

• Experience supporting technical or highly specialized talent pipelines.

• Proficiency in ATS systems (Workday preferred) and Microsoft Office tools.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans

• Generous 401 (K) savings plan

• Education assistance

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service

• And many more, check out our benefits site HERE

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Design Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

Design Engineer II - Outdoor Power Equipment (OPE)

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our engineering teams. Our Outdoor Power Equipment (OPE) Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in a mix of mechanical and electrical engineering expertise to design and develop leadership in battery powered solutions. We create Best-in-Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, test validation regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes, and cross-functional agility.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Design Engineer II is a member of a cross-functional team working in a fast-paced environment to innovate and bring to life new products from conception to production. You will own the design to create solutions that meet consumer requirements.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Perform a wide variety of calculations and software aided analyses in the following areas:

• Mechanical stress analysis, material and heat treatment selection, tolerance and fit analyses, lubrication, spur and helical gear design, statics and dynamics, noise and vibration, and a variety of machine element design.

• Evaluate product design relative to material selection, cost, and reliability.

• Participate in field research with Outdoor Power Equipment customers and Professional Landscapers.

• Develop and apply manufacturing mindset to designs to effectively and efficiently mass produce power tools.

• Work as a technical resource to troubleshoot problems with manufacturing teams and suppliers.

• Maintain regular communication with manufacturing and other global cross-functional team members to track projects to ensure adherence to schedule.

• Interact with component suppliers and manufacturers for proper component selection and developing part/product specifications that meet performance requirements while falling within process capabilities.

• Schedule, develop agendas for, facilitate, and document technical meetings and formal presentations.

• Independently develop, write, and analyze test requests with the Milwaukee Tool Test Laboratory.

• Acquire knowledge and maintain an understanding of Milwaukee Tool’s development and manufacturing processes.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

• 3+ years of design experience in a related industry.

• Proficiency in GD&T and CAD.

• Experience in participating or leading cross functional team meetings

• Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude.

• High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel and Power Point.

title: Design Engineer 3
description:
Job Description:

Design Engineer III

The Design Engineer III is responsible for hands-on mechanical design execution for moderate to high complexity outdoor power equipment (OPE) systems and subsystems. This role owns detailed design execution from concept to production, with a strong emphasis on robust design, manufacturability, validation, and cost. Operating within the Outdoor Engineering organization, the Design Engineer III functions as a technical leader and subject matter expert for assigned components and assemblies, partnering closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and global suppliers to deliver competitive, production ready designs.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Technical Design Ownership

• Owns end‑to‑end mechanical design execution for assigned components, sub‑assemblies, or systems from concept, layout, and detailed CAD through validation and production release.

• Develops and maintains 3D CAD models, 2D drawings, GD&T, tolerance stacks, and specifications to ensure functional performance, regulatory compliance, durability, safety, and manufacturability.

• Ability to analyze problems and provide design trade‑off analyses (performance, cost, weight, manufacturability, reliability) and documents rationale for design decisions.

• Applies structured problem‑solving methods to resolve design issues, field failures, and manufacturing concerns.

• Demonstrates strong engineering judgment and accountability for design quality and performance.

• Design for Manufacturing, Cost, and Quality

• Designs components optimized for high‑volume manufacturing, assembly efficiency, tooling capability, and supplier process constraints.

• Partners with Sourcing and suppliers to evaluate manufacturing processes, tooling concepts, and cost drivers early in development.

• Ensures designs comply with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable UL / ANSI / CSA / ISO expectations.

• Verification & Validation

• Defines DFMEA inputs, design risks, and mitigation strategies for owned designs.

• Develops and executes design verification plans including tolerance validation, stress analysis, durability testing, environmental testing, and abuse testing.

• Uses data‑driven test results to refine designs and confirm requirements are met with appropriate margin.

• Reviews and approves engineering changes, deviation requests, and corrective actions related to owned designs.

• Cross‑Functional Collaboration

• Works closely with Product Management to translate customer needs and CTQs into clear engineering requirements.

• Supports Manufacturing Engineering during pilot builds, PPAP, and ramp‑up by resolving build issues and incorporating feedback into design revisions.

• Collaborates with Quality, Compliance, and Reliability teams to support certifications, audits, and failure investigations.

• Provides clear technical communication to global engineering, sourcing, and supplier teams.

• Contributes to the development and improvement of design standards, test methods, and engineering processes.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 4 years of design experience in consumer, industrial, or electromechanical products.

• Strong proficiency in 3D CAD (Creo / SolidWorks / NX or equivalent), detailed drawings, and GD&T.

• Demonstrated experience with materials, manufacturing processes, tooling, and supplier‑built components.

• Experience leading design verification and validation activities using data‑driven methods.

• Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and technical communication skills.

• Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, results‑driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, small engines, or high‑load electromechanical systems.

• Hands‑on experience supporting pilot builds and production ramp‑ups.

• Familiarity with global supplier collaboration and Asia‑based manufacturing.

• Experience supporting UL / CSA / ANSI compliance activities.

Travel

• Up to 10% travel (international and domestic).

title: Electrical Engineer 1
description:
Job Description:

Electronic circuit designer of digital and analog control systems for power tools. Engineer will be responsible for design and verification of both hardware and firmware for control systems circuitry in various power tool applications with a focus on battery management systems (BMS). No prior BMS experience is required but would be a major benefit.

Job functions include development of circuit schematics and PCB layouts including component selection and generation of BOMs and well as firmware architecture and development. description:
Job Description:

The Engineering Manager, Embedded Firmware & Electrical Engineering (IoT Connectivity) will lead a team of embedded firmware, electrical, and connectivity engineers focused on designing and delivering new connected products. You will be responsible for the device connectivity architecture and strategy, strategic roadmap planning, resource allocation and scope management, oversight of technical reviews and design decisions, and process improvement and change management. This includes working in a team environment with marketing, project management, cloud and mobile software, mechanical engineering, and global manufacturing operations. This position will sit at our Headquarters in Brookfield, Wisconsin.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Build, manage, and motivate a world-class team of embedded firmware and electrical engineers to deliver new-to-world connected products.

• Own the connectivity architecture for Milwaukee Tool devices, including BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular (LTE-M/NB-IoT), and other wireless protocols, spanning hardware, firmware, and cloud/mobile interfaces.

• Lead the end-to-end design of embedded IoT devices, from concept, requirements, and architecture through schematic/PCB design, firmware development, validation, and transition to global manufacturing.

• Define IoT firmware strategy, including RTOS/Linux platforms, bootloaders, secure boot, over-the-air (OTA) updates, device provisioning, and fleet-management capabilities.

• Drive device security and compliance practices, including secure key storage, encrypted communication, vulnerability management, and regulatory certification (FCC, IC, CE/RED, Bluetooth SIG, and carrier).

• Partner with cloud, mobile app, and data teams to define device-to-cloud protocols (e.g., MQTT, CoAP, HTTPS), APIs, telemetry, and diagnostics that deliver reliable end-user experiences.

• Own RF and wireless performance, including antenna design/selection, coexistence, range, throughput, and power-consumption trade-offs in battery-powered and harsh jobsite environments.

• Organize and align across product teams and commercial managers to develop a robust connected-product strategy and development roadmap.

• Drive communication with marketing, product teams, and platform engineering to capture the voice of the customer and translate it into connectivity features and user experiences.

• Grow the team to increase project capacity while maintaining exemplary performance; recruit, develop, and retain top embedded and connectivity talent.

• Create and manage robust project roadmaps and resource plans with converged scope; drive urgency in schedules and accountability for key project metrics.

• Champion firmware and hardware development processes (CI/CD, automated and hardware-in-the-loop testing, code review, requirements traceability, and release management) suited to connected products.

• Mentor and coach the team in engineering best practices including task management, root cause analysis, firmware design, circuit/PCB design, simulation, and PCBA manufacturing.

• Lead the development of test plans, procedures, and test cases for embedded systems and connectivity subsystems, including interoperability, field, and certification testing.

• Lead technology investigations, develop system requirements, and define future architectures and reusability strategies, including common connectivity stacks and shared building blocks across products and platforms.

• Maintain strong awareness of competitive offerings, emerging wireless/IoT standards, and the business climate to shape a best-in-class roadmap.

• Quickly, effectively, and candidly frame up and escalate business risks and opportunities to senior leadership.

• Identify new innovations and strategic opportunities, including edge intelligence/ML, while considering financial impact and competitiveness.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).

• 7+ years of highly successful embedded systems experience, including hands-on design and delivery of connected/IoT devices from concept to production.

• 3+ years of team leadership experience managing embedded firmware and/or electrical engineers.

• Demonstrated experience taking multiple embedded IoT products through development, certification, manufacturing launch, and field support.

• Expertise in C/C++ embedded programming and related development tools and processes, especially microcontroller peripherals, low-power design, and RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and/or embedded Linux.

• Deep knowledge of wireless connectivity technologies and stacks (BLE required; Wi-Fi, cellular, Thread/Matter, LoRa, or mesh a plus), including RF fundamentals, antenna design, and regulatory certification.

• Experience with IoT device-to-cloud architectures, including provisioning, OTA firmware updates, device management, and protocols such as MQTT or CoAP over TLS.

• Working knowledge of embedded security best practices (secure boot, encryption, key management, threat modeling).

• Understanding of digital circuits and the interaction between firmware and electronics; ability to realize component-level design.

• Practical knowledge of analog/digital system trade-offs and design, especially signal integrity, noise analysis, power management, and margin considerations.

• Familiarity with schematic capture, PCB layout software, SPICE, and industry best practices; experience with debug and test equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, RF spectrum analyzers, protocol sniffers).

• Experience with Agile/hybrid development practices, CI/CD, and automated testing for embedded systems is preferred.

• Excellent problem-solving skills; exercises independent judgment and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment.

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders; self-motivated, organized, process-oriented, with a strong work ethic.

• Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international).

• Communicate with external customers regarding product safety matters.

• Supervise product safety testing, including preparation of test sample(s), execution of the test(s), test reporting and data analysis.

• Mentor and onboard other engineers by coaching technical judgment, facilitation skills, documentation quality, escalation discipline, and cross-functional communication.

• Review and provide feedback for operator's manuals and on-product markings.

• Requires a Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Biomedical, or related field preferred) or technical equivalent.

title: Principal Motor Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Principal Motor Engineer

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in a mix of mechanical and electrical engineering expertise to design and develop leadership in motor capabilities. We create Best-in-Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive hands-on testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes, and cross-functional agility.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started.

As a Principal Motor Engineer for Milwaukee Tool, you will be located at our Corporate & Global Design Headquarters in Brookfield, WI. You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products as a member of a cross-functional team. One of the most rewarding aspects of the job is seeing a product you designed from concept to production in the hands of professionals.

Domestic and international travel opportunities are available and sometimes required. Overseas, you will have the opportunity to work with Chinese, Vietnamese and Mexican engineering counterparts as well as meet with suppliers in other areas of the world.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Chief technical resource and mechanical engineering leader on mid/high complexity Power Tool motors platform projects with minimal guidance.

• Must be willing to take a personal hands-on approach to problem solving, rapid prototype development, and risk mitigation efforts.

• Serve as a role model of Milwaukee Tool’s culture while providing technical and engineering leadership, mentoring, guiding, and coaching junior Engineers.

• Must be capable and willing to take on agile project development cycles from white paper to mass production delivery. This includes working with MFG teams and DFM as part of the early development planning.

• Effectively identify and communicate issues to upper management in a clear, concise, and timely manner while driving action based on urgency.

• Provide technical leadership, direction, guidance and engineering expertise to colleagues and other cross-functional teams.

• Establish and drive test regimens for components and assemblies within scope of the project and organization.

• Independently track projects to ensure adherence to schedule and the Milwaukee process.

• Schedule, develop agendas for, facilitate and document technical meetings and formal presentations.

• Draw concise, logical, written conclusions from experiments based on data analysis with minimal guidance.

• Develop and maintain familiarity and understanding of Milwaukee’s development and manufacturing processes.

• Drive supplier relationships to develop part/product specifications that meet performance requirements while falling within process capabilities.

• Work with and establish trusting relationships with engineers throughout Asia and the world.

• Design to and qualify new designs to applicable regulatory standards such as UL, CEC, CE and ANSI.

• Make clean-sheet motor designs of brushless DC motors.

• Create new development tests to aid in design verification and failure modes based on risks of design.

• Perform root cause failure analysis of motor failures.

• Design and make design changes to motor components while understanding how these changes affect durability and manufacturing processes.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering. Master’s degree preferred.

• 8+ years of experience in related design field.

• Experience running and leading weekly updates to varying levels of the business.

• Tolerance Stackup Analysis

• Experienced in high-volume low-cost design and development

• Vibration and Sound analysis

• Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude.

• High proficiency in CAD; Proficiency with FEA solvers is also preferred. (NX, Ansys Preferred)

• High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel and Power Point.

• Ability to travel 10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International).

• Familiar with Brushless DC motors; Design, Prototype, and large-scale manufacturing.

• Prefer to have an understanding of motor controls, battery technology, and power tool applications.

• Good understanding of metal stamping, steel machining, and injection molded processes.

• Expert understanding of motor assembly and motor component design/manufacturing and what drives cost and durability.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

• Education assistance.

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

• And many more - check out our benefits site.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Quality Lead - Medical
description:
Job Description:

ABOUT TTI

Techtronic Industries is a fast-growing world leader in Power Tools, Accessories, Hand Tools, Outdoor Power Equipment, and Floor Care for Do-It-Yourself (DIY), professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, maintenance, construction, and infrastructure industries. The Company is committed to accelerating the transformation of these industries through superior environmentally friendly cordless technology.

JOB SUMMARY

This individual must interface with all members of Quality and Manufacturing daily to support FDA and ISO 13485 requirements as it pertains to incoming part inspection, documentation, and final release of finished goods. Responsible for interface with internal Supply Chain and external Suppliers as it relates to the approval of incoming parts; Manufacturing Assemblers as it relates to in-process assembly of medical devices. Requires daily contact with staff and middle management levels.

RESPONSIBILITIES / SKILLS

• Proactively ensure smooth team operations and effective collaboration as it relates to the performance of incoming receipt, inspection, and release of purchased parts and materials to Production.

• Manage the Finished Product Release process – document review, product release, and Certificate of Conformance creation.

• Leadership abilities to be able to train, develop, and motivate the Quality Control team.

• Be a contact point for the Quality Control team members.

• Assist the Quality Engineers in nonconforming process of defective parts and in-process units.

• Efficiently execute tasks and maintain quality by continuously monitoring processes and parts; provide immediate feedback with alternative options as necessary.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• 5+ years of quality inspection experience in Medical Device or related field.

• Bachelor’s Degree or Associate's Degree with appropriate quality experience.

• Candidate must be a self-directed, detail-oriented, dependable, and trustworthy person who works well independently, while being highly motivated.

• Use prompt judgements and actions based on professionalism and experiences to find concrete and clear solutions.

• Experience in Quality inspection, sort, and containment.

• Knowledge of MS Office, including MS Excel, MS Word, and MS PowerPoint.

• Excellent communication skills: able to read and understand technical reports, specifications, and communicate clearly with the customer.

• Ability to interface with various levels of management, suppliers, and customers.

• Experience with SAP a plus.

• FDA 21 CFR 820 and ISO 13485 knowledge preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

• Certification in a Quality discipline preferred, example CQIA, CQI, CQT

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Job requires both desk/computer work, and prolonged periods standing/moving on feet.

• Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds at times.

· Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

· Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

· Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

· Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

· Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

· Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

· Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

· Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

· Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

· The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

· Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

title: Vice President of Consumer Insights & Intelligence
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC location for a Vice President of Consumer Insights & Intelligence. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Position Summary

TTI Consumer Power Tools is seeking a strategic, highly analytical, and consumer-obsessed Vice President of Consumer Insights & Intelligence to build and lead an enterprise-class consumer insights capability.

This executive will be responsible for developing a comprehensive understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitive landscape, cultural trends, retail environment, and evolving purchase behaviors—and translating those insights into actionable strategies that drive brand growth, product innovation, consumer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, and revenue.

The VP will establish a unified Voice of the Consumer across the organization, integrating traditional research with behavioral, transactional, digital, social, retail, and first-party data to create a holistic understanding of the consumer. This leader will serve as a strategic partner to Brand Marketing, Product Development, Digital/E-commerce, Performance Marketing, Sales, Retail, Finance, and Executive Leadership.

The Mandate

The VP of Consumer Insights & Intelligence will ultimately answer three critical questions for TTI:

Who is our consumer?

What do they need next?

How do we use that knowledge to grow faster than the market?

Key Responsibilities

Consumer Insights Strategy

• Develop and lead TTI's Consumer Insights & Intelligence strategy across consumer brands, categories, and product platforms.

• Establish a comprehensive consumer understanding framework encompassing attitudes, behaviors, motivations, needs, purchase drivers, barriers, and emerging trends.

• Build a centralized Voice of the Consumer capability that informs strategic decisions across marketing, product development, innovation, retail, and customer experience.

• Identify emerging consumer behaviors and cultural shifts that represent new opportunities for TTI.

• Transform consumer research from a primarily reporting function into a proactive strategic growth capability.

Consumer Segmentation & Journey

• Develop actionable consumer segmentation models based on demographics, psychographics, behaviors, product ownership, category participation, purchase history, and lifetime value.

• Define priority consumer audiences and identify opportunities to acquire, retain, and grow high-value customer segments.

• Build comprehensive consumer journey maps from awareness and consideration through purchase, product adoption, repeat purchase, system expansion, advocacy, and loyalty.

• Identify critical moments that influence brand preference and purchasing decisions.

• Partner with marketing teams to activate consumer segments across paid, owned, earned, retail, CRM, and digital channels.

Brand & Marketing Intelligence

• Lead brand health and equity measurement, including awareness, consideration, preference, purchase intent, loyalty, advocacy, and competitive positioning.

• Develop measurement frameworks connecting consumer attitudes and marketing activity to business outcomes.

• Partner with Brand and Media teams to evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve creative, messaging, targeting, and media effectiveness.

• Lead consumer testing of brand positioning, creative platforms, communications, sponsorships, and major marketing initiatives.

• Establish competitive intelligence programs monitoring consumer perception, category dynamics, competitors, and market disruption.

Product Innovation & Consumer Validation

• Embed consumer insights throughout the product development process.

• Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Industrial Design, and Innovation teams to identify unmet consumer needs and emerging use cases.

• Develop consumer-led innovation frameworks that identify white-space opportunities for new products, categories, and services.

• Lead concept testing, product testing, pricing research, feature prioritization, and post-launch consumer evaluation.

• Ensure that product development decisions are grounded in meaningful end-user insights and market opportunity.

Data, Analytics & AI

• Integrate traditional research with first-party consumer data, CRM, e-commerce, retail, media, social listening, search behavior, customer service, product reviews, and third-party market intelligence.

• Partner with Data & Analytics teams to develop a unified view of the consumer across platforms and channels.

• Build predictive models to identify consumer demand, category opportunities, purchase propensity, churn risk, cross-sell opportunities, and lifetime value.

• Introduce AI-enabled consumer intelligence tools that accelerate research, identify emerging trends, analyze consumer sentiment, and uncover behavioral patterns.

• Develop executive dashboards that translate complex consumer data into clear, actionable business insights.

Retail & Shopper Insights

•
Build a robust understanding of how consumers research, evaluate, and purchase products across physical retail, e-commerce, marketplaces, and direct digital environments.

•
Partner with Sales and Retail Marketing teams to understand shopper behavior and improve conversion.

•
Analyze retailer, category, promotional, pricing, and competitive data to identify growth opportunities.

•
Develop insights supporting assortment, merchandising, promotional strategy, product launches, and retail activation.

•
Connect consumer insights with shopper insights to understand the complete path to purchase.

Research Leadership

• Oversee TTI's portfolio of quantitative and qualitative research, including brand tracking, consumer segmentation, usage and attitude studies, concept and product testing, pricing research, creative testing, customer satisfaction/NPS, social listening, digital behavioral analysis, retail/shopper research, competitive intelligence, market sizing, and category forecasting.

• Continuously modernize research methodologies to improve the speed, quality, and business impact of consumer intelligence.

Executive Leadership & Organizational Influence

• Serve as the senior consumer advocate within TTI Consumer Power Tools.

• Translate complex research and data into clear strategic recommendations for executive leadership.

• Influence major decisions involving brand strategy, innovation, product portfolio, marketing investment, retail strategy, and long-term growth.

• Create a culture where major business decisions begin with a clear understanding of the consumer.

• Develop and lead a high-performing Consumer Insights & Intelligence organization.

• Build strong partnerships across Brand Marketing, Product, Sales, Digital, E-commerce, Media, Finance, IT/Data, and Executive Leadership.

Key Performance Indicators

• Brand awareness, consideration and preference

• Consumer acquisition and penetration

• Brand health and equity

• Customer retention and loyalty

• Net Promoter Score / advocacy

• Consumer lifetime value

• Product adoption and system expansion

• New-product success rates

• Marketing effectiveness and ROI

• Consumer segmentation activation

• Research speed-to-insight

• Forecast accuracy

• Retail/shopper conversion

• Revenue contribution from insight-driven initiatives

Qualifications

• 15+ years of progressive experience in Consumer Insights, Market Research, Consumer Strategy, Analytics, Brand Strategy, or related disciplines.

• 7+ years of senior leadership experience building and managing high-performing teams.

• Experience within consumer products, durable goods, home improvement, tools, outdoor products, automotive, technology, retail, or similarly complex consumer categories strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to translate consumer insights into measurable commercial growth.

• Deep expertise in quantitative and qualitative research methodologies.

• Strong understanding of first-party data, digital analytics, CRM, segmentation, attribution, social listening, and modern consumer-data ecosystems.

• Experience applying AI, predictive analytics, and advanced data science to consumer and marketing challenges.

• Experience working with major retailers and understanding omnichannel shopper behavior strongly preferred.

• Proven ability to influence C-suite executives and cross-functional senior leaders.

• Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex information into decisive business recommendations.

• Bachelor's degree required; MBA, advanced analytics, behavioral science, marketing, or related graduate degree preferred.

Leadership Profile

Consumer Obsessed — Constantly seeking to understand what consumers need, why they behave as they do, and where their needs are heading.

Commercially Minded — Connects consumer understanding directly to revenue, margin, market share, innovation, and enterprise value.

Strategic & Analytical — Combines rigorous analysis with strong business judgment.

Action Oriented — Moves beyond reporting what happened to recommending what TTI should do next.

Digitally Fluent — Understands the intersection of consumer behavior, technology, data, media, e-commerce, and retail.

Innovative — Embraces AI and emerging research methodologies to dramatically increase the speed and depth of consumer understanding.

Influential — Can challenge conventional thinking and build organizational alignment around the consumer.

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provides TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Hart ®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this position, you will drive sales of our premier product lines within one of our largest retail partners. This position will allow you to enhance your selling, account management, and communication skills while launching your career in a fast-paced and extremely rewarding company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

·        Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm

·        Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through

·        Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through

·        Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact

·        Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics

·        Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market

·        Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships

·        Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities

·        Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies)

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holidays (Based on hire date)

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. Reporting to a Manager of Quality / Reliability, the Quality Engineer's primary responsibility is to support the successful launch of new products by driving manufacturing quality readiness, risk visibility, issue management, and cross-site alignment throughout the NPD lifecycle. The QE serves as a quality liaison between domestic new product development teams and global manufacturing organizations, helping to ensure that supplier readiness, process controls, fixture readiness, documentation robustness, and production readiness activities are completed with appropriate visibility and alignment. The role offers opportunities to influence new product development, improve launch quality performance, and drive continuous improvement across global manufacturing operations.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Support creation, maintenance, and communication of NPD project quality readiness status, risks, issues, and closure plans.

• Assist in maintaining project Quality Readiness tracking and ensuring manufacturing quality risks are documented and communicated throughout the project lifecycle.

• Participate in supplier risk reviews, manufacturing risk reviews, PFMEA reviews, control plan reviews, and production readiness activities.

• Support development and alignment of production test plans, fixture readiness plans, process controls, and manufacturing quality documentation.

• Help coordinate quality readiness activities between domestic teams and global factory Advanced Quality Engineering, SQE, AME, and Operations organizations.

• Track manufacturing, process, supplier, and quality issues identified during builds and support closure activities.

• Participate in Engineering Builds, Qualification Builds, and Production Readiness reviews and audits.

• Assist with execution and documentation of process audits, quality audits, and production readiness assessments.

• Support cross-site communication of lessons learned, process updates, PFMEA updates, PCP updates, and open quality concerns.

• Prepare project quality summaries, dashboards, status reports, and milestone review content for leadership and project teams.

• Identify opportunities for process improvement, quality system enhancements, and manufacturing risk reduction.

• Consistent global, onsite engagement critical to success.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, or equivalent education and experience.

• 1-3 years of experience in quality, manufacturing, reliability, operations, supplier quality, or related engineering disciplines.

• Understanding of quality systems, risk management tools, process controls, and structured problem-solving methodologies.

• Familiarity with PFMEA, Control Plans, Work Instructions, Process Audits, and Corrective Action systems preferred.

• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to effectively collaborate across multiple functions and global teams.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

• Experience with quality, manufacturing, or data-analysis tools is a plus.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 30%.
